source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן עַ֖ל כָּל־גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if listening you listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God, to keep to do all his commandments which I [am] commanding you today, and will set you Yahweh your God high above all [the] nations of the earth.

en.L: And it will be, if you carefully listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, taking care to do all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments that I am commanding you today, that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
en.B: If you truly obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and carefully keep all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments that I am giving you today, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will raise you high above every nation on earth.
en.R: Obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God completely, and be careful to do all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands that I am giving you today. If you do, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will make you greater than all the nations on earth.

es.L: Y sucederá que, si escuchas atentamente la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, cuidando de poner por obra todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos que yo te mando hoy, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te pondrá en alto sobre todas las naciones de la tierra.
es.B: Si de verdad obedeces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y cumples con cuidado todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos que hoy te doy, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te elevará por encima de todas las naciones de la tierra.
es.R: Obedece por completo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y procura cumplir todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos que hoy te doy. Si lo haces, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te hará más grande que todas las naciones de la tierra.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, si tu écoutes attentivement la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, en veillant à pratiquer tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements que je te commande aujourd’hui, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te placera haut au-dessus de toutes les nations de la terre.
fr.B: Si tu obéis vraiment {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu veilles à mettre en pratique tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements que je te donne aujourd’hui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’élèvera bien au-dessus de toutes les nations de la terre.
fr.R: Obéis entièrement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et applique-toi à faire tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements demandent, ceux que je te donne aujourd’hui. Si tu le fais, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te rendra plus grand que toutes les nations de la terre.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, ukiisikiliza kwa makini sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ukijali kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote ninazokuamuru leo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakuweka juu sana kuliko mataifa yote ya dunia.
sw.B: Ukimtii kweli {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuzishika kwa uangalifu amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote ninazokupa leo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakuinua juu kuliko kila taifa duniani.
sw.R: Mtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kikamilifu, na uwe mwangalifu kutenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote ninazokupa leo. Ukifanya hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakufanya kuwa mkuu kuliko mataifa yote duniani.

decisions.choice: listening you listen: listen closely, obey fully
decisions.reason: The verb "listen" is doubled, which makes it emphatic: really listen. To "listen to the voice" of the LORD means to obey him, as the next words show: "taking care to do all his commandments" (15:5; 13:19).

decisions.choice: And it will be, if: the condition on which the blessings depend
decisions.reason: The chapter sets out two ways. If Israel obeys, the blessings of verses 1-14 follow; if it does not, the curses of verses 15-68 follow. It goes on from the ceremony of blessing and curse that Moses has just ordered for Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal (27:12-26; 11:26-29).

decisions.choice: high: raised in honor above the other nations
decisions.reason: The word means "highest, uppermost". The LORD has already promised to set Israel high above all nations "in praise, in name and in honor" (26:19); verse 13 says the same with the picture of head and tail.

decisions.choice: no opening quotation mark
decisions.reason: Moses' words opened at 27:12 and run on to the end of 28:68, where the double quotation mark closes; this record has none.

decisions.choice: truly obey (Balanced); Obey ... completely (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "listen to the voice". Balanced and Readable say "obey", which is what the phrase means, and carry the doubled verb with "truly" and "completely".

decisions.choice: Obey ... If you do,
decisions.reason: Readable turns the long condition into two plain commands and then gives the promise in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "tú", "tu Dios" (singular, no plural_you span)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses Israel as one "you" through almost the whole chapter, so Spanish uses "tú" and no plural_you span except where the Hebrew turns plural (verses 14, 62-63, 68).

decisions.choice: "tu", "ton Dieu" (singular)
decisions.reason: In this chapter Moses speaks to Israel as one "you" (singular), as the Hebrew does almost throughout; French follows the Hebrew number at every level, with "vous" only where the Hebrew turns plural (verses 14, 62-63, 68).

source.text: וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־הַבְּרָכ֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will come on you all the blessings these and overtake you, if you listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God.

en.L: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: All these blessings will come on you and catch up with you, if you obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: If you obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, all these blessings will come to you. They will follow you and find you.

es.L: Y vendrán sobre ti todas estas bendiciones y te alcanzarán, si escuchas la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Todas estas bendiciones vendrán sobre ti y te darán alcance, si obedeces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.R: Si obedeces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, todas estas bendiciones vendrán a ti. Te seguirán hasta encontrarte.

fr.L: Et toutes ces bénédictions viendront sur toi et t’atteindront, si tu écoutes la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: Toutes ces bénédictions viendront sur toi et te rattraperont, si tu obéis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.R: Si tu obéis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu, toutes ces bénédictions viendront à toi. Elles te suivront jusqu’à te trouver.

sw.L: Na baraka hizi zote zitakuja juu yako na kukupata, ukiisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Baraka hizi zote zitakujia na kukufikia, ukimtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.R: Ukimtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, baraka hizi zote zitakujia. Zitakufuata mpaka zikupate.

decisions.choice: overtake: catch up with, reach
decisions.reason: The verb is used of someone who pursues and catches up with another (19:6; Exodus 14:9). The blessings are pictured as running after Israel until they reach it. The same words are used of the curses in verses 15 and 45.

decisions.choice: catch up with you (Balanced); follow you and find you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the picture of pursuit in plain words; Literal says "overtake". The same wording is used for the curses in verses 15 and 45.

source.text: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [are] you in the city, and blessed [are] you in the field.

en.L: Blessed [are] you in the city, and blessed [are] you in the field.
en.B: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the countryside.
en.R: You will be blessed in town and in the country.

es.L: Bendito [eres] tú en la ciudad, y bendito [eres] tú en el campo.
es.B: Serás bendecido en la ciudad y bendecido en el campo.
es.R: Tendrás bendición en la ciudad y en el campo.

fr.L: Béni [es]-tu dans la ville, et béni [es]-tu dans les champs.
fr.B: Tu seras béni à la ville et béni à la campagne.
fr.R: Tu seras béni en ville comme à la campagne.

sw.L: Umebarikiwa wewe mjini, na umebarikiwa wewe shambani.
sw.B: Utabarikiwa ukiwa mjini, na utabarikiwa ukiwa shambani.
sw.R: Utabarikiwa mjini na vijijini.

decisions.choice: Blessed are you: a declaration of what will be
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb, only "blessed you". In this setting, after verse 2, it declares what will come to pass if Israel obeys. The six lines of verses 3-6 are matched by six curses in verses 16-19.

decisions.choice: in the city and in the field: everywhere you live and work
decisions.reason: The pair covers the whole of life: the walled town where people lived and the open country where they farmed and kept flocks.

decisions.choice: You will be blessed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the statement a future, as the promise of verse 2 implies. Literal keeps "Blessed [are] you", bracketing the verb. Verse 16 uses the same wording with "cursed".

source.text: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֛ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [is the] fruit of your womb and [the] fruit of your ground and [the] fruit of your livestock, [the] young of your cattle and [the] young of your flock.

en.L: Blessed [is] the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground and the fruit of your livestock, the offspring of your cattle and the young of your flock.
en.B: Blessed will be the children you bear, the harvest of your soil and the young of your livestock, the young of your cattle and your sheep.
en.R: Your children will be blessed, and your crops, and the young of your animals, the calves in your herds and the lambs in your flocks.

es.L: Bendito [es] el fruto de tu vientre, y el fruto de tu suelo, y el fruto de tu ganado, la cría de tus vacas y las crías de tus ovejas.
es.B: Benditos serán los hijos que tengas, la cosecha de tu suelo y las crías de tu ganado, las crías de tus vacas y de tus ovejas.
es.R: Tus hijos serán bendecidos, y también tus cosechas y las crías de tus animales, los terneros de tus manadas y los corderos de tus rebaños.

fr.L: Béni [est] le fruit de ton sein, et le fruit de ton sol, et le fruit de ton bétail, la portée de tes vaches et les petits de ton petit bétail.
fr.B: Bénis seront les enfants que tu mettras au monde, la récolte de ton sol et les petits de ton bétail, les petits de tes vaches et de tes brebis.
fr.R: Tes enfants seront bénis, ainsi que tes récoltes et les petits de tes animaux, les veaux de tes troupeaux et les agneaux de tes moutons.

sw.L: Limebarikiwa tunda la tumbo lako, na tunda la ardhi yako, na tunda la mifugo yako, uzao wa ng'ombe wako na wadogo wa kundi lako la kondoo.
sw.B: Watabarikiwa watoto utakaowazaa, na mavuno ya ardhi yako, na wadogo wa mifugo yako: ndama wa ng'ombe wako na wana-kondoo wa kondoo wako.
sw.R: Watoto wako watabarikiwa, pamoja na mazao yako na wadogo wa wanyama wako, yaani ndama katika makundi yako ya ng'ombe na wana-kondoo katika makundi yako ya kondoo.

decisions.choice: fruit of your womb, of your ground, of your livestock: children, crops and young animals
decisions.reason: "Fruit" is what comes from something: children from the womb, harvests from the ground, young from the animals. The list repeats the promise of 7:13 and comes back in verses 11, 18 and 51.

decisions.choice: offspring of your cattle, young of your flock
decisions.reason: These are ordinary words for the young born to cattle and to sheep and goats, as in 7:13. They spell out what "the fruit of your livestock" means.

decisions.choice: children you bear, harvest of your soil, young of your livestock; calves, lambs
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the pictures mean, as at 7:13; Literal keeps "fruit". The same wording is used in verse 18.

source.text: בָּר֥וּךְ טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [is] your basket and your kneading bowl.

en.L: Blessed [is] your basket and your kneading bowl.
en.B: Blessed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.
en.R: The basket you gather your harvest in and the bowl you make bread in will be blessed.

es.L: Bendita [es] tu canasta y tu artesa.
es.B: Benditas serán tu canasta y tu artesa.
es.R: La canasta en que recoges tu cosecha y la vasija en que amasas tu pan serán bendecidas.

fr.L: Bénis [sont] ton panier et ton pétrin.
fr.B: Bénis seront ton panier et ton pétrin.
fr.R: Le panier où tu ranges ta récolte et le bol où tu pétris ton pain seront bénis.

sw.L: Kimebarikiwa kikapu chako na chombo chako cha kukandia unga.
sw.B: Vitabarikiwa kikapu chako na chombo chako cha kukandia unga.
sw.R: Kikapu unachokusanyia mavuno yako na bakuli unalokandia unga wa mkate vitabarikiwa.

decisions.choice: basket and kneading bowl: the harvest and the daily bread made from it
decisions.reason: The basket held produce gathered from the fields, as in the offering of first fruits (26:2, 4). The kneading bowl was where dough was mixed and kneaded for bread (Exodus 12:34). Together they stand for food from the harvest to the table.

decisions.choice: you gather your harvest in; you make bread in
decisions.reason: Readable says what each container was used for, so the reader sees that the blessing is on food. Verse 17 uses the same wording with "cursed".

source.text: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [are] you in your coming in, and blessed [are] you in your going out.

en.L: Blessed [are] you in your coming in, and blessed [are] you in your going out.
en.B: You will be blessed as you come in and blessed as you go out.
en.R: You will be blessed when you come in and when you go out, in everything you do.

es.L: Bendito [eres] tú en tu entrar, y bendito [eres] tú en tu salir.
es.B: Serás bendecido al entrar y bendecido al salir.
es.R: Tendrás bendición cuando entres y cuando salgas, en todo lo que hagas.

fr.L: Béni [es]-tu à ton entrée, et béni [es]-tu à ta sortie.
fr.B: Tu seras béni quand tu entreras et béni quand tu sortiras.
fr.R: Tu seras béni quand tu rentreras et quand tu sortiras, dans tout ce que tu feras.

sw.L: Umebarikiwa wewe katika kuingia kwako, na umebarikiwa wewe katika kutoka kwako.
sw.B: Utabarikiwa unapoingia na utabarikiwa unapotoka.
sw.R: Utabarikiwa unaporudi nyumbani na unapotoka, katika kila jambo unalofanya.

decisions.choice: coming in and going out: all of your daily activity
decisions.reason: The pair covers every movement of life, going out to work or to war and coming home again (31:2; Psalm 121:8).

decisions.choice: in everything you do
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the pair means. Verse 19 uses the same wording with "cursed".

source.text: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will make Yahweh your enemies who rise against you defeated before you; by way one they will come out against you, and by seven ways they will flee before you.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make your enemies who rise up against you defeated before you; by one way they will come out against you, and by seven ways they will flee before you.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will let you defeat the enemies who rise up against you. They will march out against you by one road and flee from you by seven.
en.R: When enemies attack you, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will let you defeat them. They will come at you from one direction, but they will run away from you in seven directions.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que tus enemigos que se levantan contra ti sean derrotados delante de ti; por un camino saldrán contra ti, y por siete caminos huirán delante de ti.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará la victoria sobre los enemigos que se levanten contra ti. Saldrán contra ti por un camino y huirán de ti por siete.
es.R: Cuando los enemigos te ataquen, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que los venzas. Vendrán contra ti desde una dirección, pero huirán de ti en siete direcciones.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendra tes ennemis qui se lèvent contre toi battus devant toi ; par un seul chemin ils sortiront contre toi, et par sept chemins ils fuiront devant toi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera de battre les ennemis qui se dressent contre toi. Ils marcheront contre toi par une seule route et s’enfuiront devant toi par sept.
fr.R: Quand des ennemis t’attaqueront, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te permettra de les vaincre. Ils viendront contre toi d’un seul côté, mais ils s’enfuiront devant toi dans sept directions.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawafanya adui zako wanaoinuka dhidi yako kupigwa mbele yako; kwa njia moja watatoka dhidi yako, na kwa njia saba watakimbia mbele yako.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwezesha kuwashinda adui wanaoinuka dhidi yako. Watakujia kwa njia moja na kukukimbia kwa njia saba.
sw.R: Adui watakapokushambulia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwezesha kuwashinda. Watakujia kutoka upande mmoja, lakini watakukimbia pande saba.

decisions.choice: by one way ... by seven ways: they come as one army and scatter in every direction
decisions.reason: The enemy marches out in good order along one road and runs away in panic along many. Seven is a number of fullness: they scatter every way they can. Verse 25 turns the same picture against Israel.

decisions.choice: will make ... defeated before you: the LORD gives the victory
decisions.reason: The LORD is the subject: he is the one who strikes the enemy down, though Israel fights the battle (20:4).

decisions.choice: will let you defeat
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "make ... defeated before you". Balanced and Readable make Israel the one who defeats, with the LORD as the one who lets it happen.

source.text: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will command Yahweh with you the blessing in your barns and in all [the] undertaking of your hand, and he will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will command the blessing to be with you in your barns and in all the undertaking of your hand, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless you in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving to you.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will command blessing to be with you in your barns and in everything you set your hand to. He will bless you in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give the order, and blessing will fill your barns and rest on all your work. He will bless you in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandará que la bendición esté contigo en tus graneros y en toda empresa de tu mano, y te bendecirá en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ordenará que la bendición te acompañe en tus graneros y en todo lo que emprendas. Te bendecirá en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dará la orden, y la bendición llenará tus graneros y estará sobre todo tu trabajo. Te bendecirá en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} commandera à la bénédiction d’être avec toi dans tes greniers et dans toute entreprise de ta main, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te bénira dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ordonnera à la bénédiction d’être avec toi dans tes greniers et dans tout ce que tu entreprendras. Il te bénira dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera l’ordre, et la bénédiction remplira tes greniers et reposera sur tout ton travail. Il te bénira dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataamuru baraka iwe pamoja nawe katika ghala zako na katika kila kazi ya mkono wako, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atakubariki katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataamuru baraka ikae nawe katika ghala zako na katika kila unachokishughulikia. Atakubariki katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatoa amri, na baraka itajaza ghala zako na kukaa juu ya kazi yako yote. Atakubariki katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.

decisions.choice: command the blessing: order blessing to come by his word
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks and the blessing comes, as a king's command is carried out (Leviticus 25:21; Psalm 133:3).

decisions.choice: the undertaking of your hand: whatever you work at
decisions.reason: The phrase means everything a person sets to work on and what it produces (12:7; 15:10).

decisions.choice: blessing will fill your barns
decisions.reason: Readable says what the blessing in the barns means: stores of grain. Literal and Balanced keep "the blessing ... in your barns".

source.text: יְקִֽימְךָ֨יְהוָ֥ה לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם קָד֔וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Will establish you Yahweh for himself as a people holy, just as he swore to you, if you keep [the] commandments of Yahweh your God and walk in his ways.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will establish you for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} as a holy people, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to you, if you keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you a people holy to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised you on oath, as long as you keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and follow {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own holy people, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised you with an oath. But you must obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants you to live.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te establecerá como pueblo santo para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}, tal como te lo juró, si guardas los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y andas en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará de ti un pueblo santo para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}, como te lo prometió con juramento, siempre que guardes los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y sigas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará de ti {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo santo, como te lo prometió con juramento. Pero tienes que obedecer los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y vivir como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere que vivas.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’établira pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme un peuple saint, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te l’a juré, si tu gardes les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et si tu marches dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de toi un peuple saint pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te l’a promis par serment, pourvu que tu gardes les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu suives {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de toi {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple saint, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te l’a promis par serment. Mais tu dois obéir aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et vivre comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut que tu vives.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuthibitisha kuwa taifa takatifu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, kama alivyokuapia, ukizishika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuenenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya kuwa taifa takatifu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama alivyokuahidi kwa kiapo, ilimradi uzishike amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kufuata njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya kuwa taifa {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu, kama alivyokuahidi kwa kiapo. Lakini lazima uzitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuishi kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anavyotaka uishi.

decisions.choice: a holy people for himself: set apart as his own
decisions.reason: Israel is holy because the LORD has chosen it and set it apart to belong to him (7:6; 14:2; 26:19; Exodus 19:5-6).

decisions.choice: establish: raise up and make firm
decisions.reason: The verb means to set up and confirm, so that what is promised stands and lasts. The LORD will make Israel firmly what he has sworn it will be.

decisions.choice: walk in his ways: live as he directs
decisions.reason: Walking stands for the whole way a person lives (8:6; 10:12; 11:22).

decisions.choice: live the way he wants you to live
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom "walk in his ways"; Literal and Balanced keep the picture.

source.text: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will see all [the] peoples of the earth that [the] name of Yahweh is called over you, and they will be afraid of you.

en.L: And all the peoples of the earth will see that the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is called over you, and they will be afraid of you.
en.B: Then every people on earth will see that you bear the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will be afraid of you.
en.R: Then all the nations on earth will see that you belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will be afraid of you.

es.L: Y todos los pueblos de la tierra verán que el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es pronunciado sobre ti, y te temerán.
es.B: Entonces todos los pueblos de la tierra verán que llevas el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y te tendrán miedo.
es.R: Entonces todas las naciones de la tierra verán que perteneces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y te tendrán miedo.

fr.L: Et tous les peuples de la terre verront que le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est prononcé sur toi, et ils te craindront.
fr.B: Alors tous les peuples de la terre verront que tu portes le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils te craindront.
fr.R: Alors toutes les nations de la terre verront que tu appartiens {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et elles auront peur de toi.

sw.L: Na mataifa yote ya dunia yataona kwamba jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} linaitwa juu yako, nayo yatakuogopa.
sw.B: Ndipo mataifa yote duniani yataona kwamba wewe unaitwa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nayo yatakuogopa.
sw.R: Ndipo mataifa yote duniani yataona kwamba wewe ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nayo yatakuogopa.

decisions.choice: the name of the LORD is called over you: you belong to him
decisions.reason: To have someone's name called over a thing or a people means that it belongs to him (2 Samuel 12:28; Jeremiah 14:9). The nations will see that Israel is the LORD's own people.

decisions.choice: afraid of you: in awe of the people the LORD protects
decisions.reason: The nations fear Israel because of the God who stands behind it, as promised in 2:25 and 11:25.

decisions.choice: bear the name (Balanced); belong to (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced makes Israel the subject; Readable says what the idiom means. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

source.text: וְהוֹתִֽרְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will make you abound Yahweh in good, in [the] fruit of your womb and in [the] fruit of your livestock and in [the] fruit of your ground, on the ground which swore Yahweh to your fathers to give to you.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you abound in good things, in the fruit of your womb and in the fruit of your livestock and in the fruit of your ground, on the ground that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} swore to your fathers to give to you.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you plenty of good things: many children, many young among your livestock and rich harvests from your soil, in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} swore to your ancestors to give you.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you more than enough of everything good. You will have many children, many young animals and big harvests. All this will be in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised your ancestors with an oath to give you.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará abundar en bienes, en el fruto de tu vientre, y en el fruto de tu ganado, y en el fruto de tu suelo, sobre el suelo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró a tus padres que te daría.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará abundancia de bienes: muchos hijos, muchas crías en tu ganado y ricas cosechas de tu suelo, en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró a tus antepasados que te daría.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará más que suficiente de todo lo bueno. Tendrás muchos hijos, muchas crías de animales y grandes cosechas. Todo esto será en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prometió con juramento a tus antepasados que te daría.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fera surabonder en biens, dans le fruit de ton sein, et dans le fruit de ton bétail, et dans le fruit de ton sol, sur le sol que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré à tes pères de te donner.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te comblera de biens : beaucoup d’enfants, beaucoup de petits dans ton bétail et de riches récoltes de ton sol, dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré à tes ancêtres de te donner.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera plus qu’assez de tout ce qui est bon. Tu auras beaucoup d’enfants, beaucoup de jeunes animaux et de grandes récoltes. Tout cela se passera dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis par serment à tes ancêtres de te donner.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuzidishia mema, katika tunda la tumbo lako, na katika tunda la mifugo yako, na katika tunda la ardhi yako, katika ardhi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaapia baba zako kwamba atakupa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa mema tele: watoto wengi, wadogo wengi wa mifugo yako na mavuno mengi ya ardhi yako, katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaapia mababu zako kwamba atakupa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa mema yote kwa wingi kupita kiasi. Utakuwa na watoto wengi, wanyama wachanga wengi na mavuno makubwa. Hayo yote yatakuwa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaahidi mababu zako kwa kiapo kwamba atakupa.

decisions.choice: make you abound in good: give you more than enough
decisions.reason: The verb means to leave over, to give in excess. "Good" here is prosperity, the good things of the land.

decisions.choice: swore to your fathers: the promise of the land to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: The land is the one the LORD promised on oath to Israel's ancestors (1:8; Genesis 12:7; 26:3; 28:13).

decisions.choice: many children, many young, rich harvests
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the three kinds of "fruit" are, as in verse 4, and carry "abound" into "many" and "rich". Literal keeps "fruit".

source.text: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀לְ֠ךָ אֶת־אוֹצָר֨וֹ הַטּ֜וֹב אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר־אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֨יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Will open Yahweh for you his storehouse the good, the heavens, to give [the] rain of your land in its time and to bless all [the] work of your hand; and you will lend to nations many, and you will not borrow.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will open for you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} good storehouse, the heavens, to give the rain of your land in its season and to bless all the work of your hand; and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will open for you the heavens, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rich storehouse, to send rain on your land at the right time and to bless all that your hands do. You will lend to many nations and borrow from none.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will open the sky, where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} good gifts, and send rain on your land at the right time. He will bless all your work. You will lend to many nations, but you will not need to borrow from any.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te abrirá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} buen almacén, los cielos, para dar la lluvia de tu tierra a su tiempo y para bendecir toda la obra de tu mano; y prestarás a muchas naciones, y tú no pedirás prestado.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te abrirá los cielos, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rico almacén, para enviar la lluvia sobre tu tierra en el momento oportuno y para bendecir todo lo que hagan tus manos. Prestarás a muchas naciones y no pedirás prestado a ninguna.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} abrirá el cielo, donde guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} buenos regalos, y enviará lluvia sobre tu tierra en el momento oportuno. Bendecirá todo tu trabajo. Prestarás a muchas naciones, pero no tendrás que pedir prestado a ninguna.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’ouvrira {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonne réserve, les cieux, pour donner la pluie de ton pays en sa saison et pour bénir tout l’ouvrage de ta main ; et tu prêteras à des nations nombreuses, mais toi, tu n’emprunteras pas.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’ouvrira les cieux, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} riche réserve, pour envoyer la pluie sur ton pays au bon moment et pour bénir tout ce que font tes mains. Tu prêteras à beaucoup de nations et tu n’emprunteras à aucune.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ouvrira le ciel, où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} bons cadeaux, et enverra la pluie sur ton pays au bon moment. Il bénira tout ton travail. Tu prêteras à beaucoup de nations, mais tu n’auras besoin d’emprunter à aucune.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufungulia ghala {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nzuri, mbingu, ili kutoa mvua ya nchi yako kwa majira yake na kuibariki kazi yote ya mkono wako; nawe utakopesha mataifa mengi, wala wewe hutakopa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufungulia mbingu, ghala {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tajiri, ili kunyesha mvua juu ya nchi yako kwa wakati unaofaa na kubariki yote yanayofanywa na mikono yako. Utayakopesha mataifa mengi, wala hutakopa kwa taifa lolote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafungua anga, mahali anapoweka zawadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} nzuri, na kunyesha mvua juu ya nchi yako kwa wakati unaofaa. Ataibariki kazi yako yote. Utayakopesha mataifa mengi, lakini hutahitaji kukopa kwa taifa lolote.

decisions.choice: his good storehouse, the heavens: the sky as the store of rain
decisions.reason: The sky is pictured as a storehouse from which the LORD sends rain (Job 38:22; Jeremiah 10:13). The land of Canaan depended on rain, not on a river as Egypt did (11:10-14).

decisions.choice: in its season: the autumn and spring rains
decisions.reason: The rains had to come at the right times for sowing and for the ripening of the crops (11:14).

decisions.choice: lend to many nations and not borrow: wealth and freedom
decisions.reason: The lender has power and the borrower depends on him (15:6; Proverbs 22:7). Verse 44 turns this around.

decisions.choice: where he keeps his good gifts
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the storehouse. Literal and Balanced keep it.

source.text: וּנְתָֽנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֨יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי־תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־מִצְוֺ֣ת׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And will make you Yahweh [the] head and not [the] tail, and you will be only above and not you will be below, if you listen to [the] commandments of Yahweh your God which I [am] commanding you today to keep and to do,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you the head and not the tail, and you will be only above and you will not be below, if you listen to the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am commanding you today, to keep and to do [them],
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you the head, never the tail; you will always be at the top and never at the bottom, if you heed the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you today and carefully keep them,
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you the leader and not the follower. You will always be on top, never at the bottom. But you must listen to the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you today, and be careful to obey them.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará de ti la cabeza y no la cola, y estarás solamente arriba y no estarás abajo, si escuchas los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios que yo te mando hoy, para guardar[los] y poner[los] por obra,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará de ti la cabeza, nunca la cola; siempre estarás en lo alto y nunca abajo, si atiendes a los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios que hoy te doy y los guardas con cuidado,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que tú seas quien dirige y no quien sigue. Siempre estarás arriba, nunca abajo. Pero tienes que escuchar los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios que hoy te doy, y cumplirlos con cuidado.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de toi la tête et non la queue, et tu seras seulement en haut et tu ne seras pas en bas, si tu écoutes les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu que je te commande aujourd’hui, pour [les] garder et [les] pratiquer,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de toi la tête, jamais la queue ; tu seras toujours en haut et jamais en bas, si tu prêtes attention aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu que je te donne aujourd’hui et que tu les gardes avec soin,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de toi celui qui dirige, et non celui qui suit. Tu seras toujours en haut, jamais en bas. Mais tu dois écouter les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu que je te donne aujourd’hui, et veiller à leur obéir.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuweka uwe kichwa wala usiwe mkia; utakuwa juu peke yake, wala hutakuwa chini, ukizisikiliza amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ninazokuamuru leo, [ili] kuzishika na kuzitenda,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya uwe kichwa, kamwe si mkia; daima utakuwa juu na kamwe hutakuwa chini, ukizitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ninazokupa leo na kuzishika kwa uangalifu,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya kiongozi, wala si mfuasi. Daima utakuwa juu, kamwe si chini. Lakini lazima usikilize amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ninazokupa leo, na kuwa mwangalifu kuzitii.

decisions.choice: head and not tail: leading, not following
decisions.reason: The head goes first and leads; the tail comes last. The picture is of honor and power among the nations (Isaiah 9:13-14). Verse 44 reverses it.

decisions.choice: if you listen ...: the condition goes on into verse 14
decisions.reason: The sentence does not end here: the condition includes not turning aside to other gods in verse 14.

decisions.choice: the leader and not the follower
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means; Literal and Balanced keep "head" and "tail".

decisions.choice: [them]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the object that English needs for "to keep and to do".

source.text: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִכָּל־הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and not you turn aside from any of the words which I [am] commanding you today, right or left, to go after gods other to serve them.

en.L: and [if] you do not turn aside from any of the words that I am commanding you today, [to the] right or [to the] left, to go after other gods to serve them.
en.B: and if you do not turn from any of the words I am giving you today, either to the right or to the left, to follow other gods and serve them.
en.R: Do not turn away from anything I am commanding you today, not even a little. Do not follow other gods and worship them.

es.L: y [si] no te apartas de ninguna de las palabras que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando hoy, [ni a la] derecha ni a [la] izquierda, para ir tras otros dioses para servirlos.
es.B: y si no te desvías de ninguna de las palabras que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} doy, ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda, para seguir a otros dioses y servirlos.
es.R: No te apartes de nada de lo que hoy te mando, ni siquiera un poco. No sigas a otros dioses ni los adores.

fr.L: et [si] tu ne t’écartes d’aucune des paroles que je vous commande aujourd’hui, [ni à] droite ni à gauche, pour aller après d’autres dieux afin de les servir.
fr.B: et si tu ne te détournes d’aucune des paroles que je vous donne aujourd’hui, ni à droite ni à gauche, pour suivre d’autres dieux et les servir.
fr.R: Ne te détourne de rien de ce que je te commande aujourd’hui, pas même un peu. Ne suis pas d’autres dieux pour les adorer.

sw.L: na [kama] hutageuka kuacha neno lolote kati ya maneno ninayowaamuru leo, [kwenda] kulia wala kushoto, ili kuifuata miungu mingine kuitumikia.
sw.B: na usipogeuka kuacha neno lolote ninalowaamuru leo, kwenda kulia wala kushoto, ili kuifuata miungu mingine na kuitumikia.
sw.R: Usigeuke kuacha chochote ninachokuamuru leo, hata kidogo. Usiifuate miungu mingine na kuiabudu.

decisions.choice: right or left: the smallest departure from the way
decisions.reason: Turning to either side of the road means leaving the path the LORD has set, even a little (5:32; 17:11, 20).

decisions.choice: go after other gods to serve them: follow and worship them
decisions.reason: To "go after" a god is to follow it as a loyal subject; to "serve" it is to worship it (6:14; 8:19; 11:28).

decisions.choice: not even a little; worship
decisions.reason: Readable explains "right or left" and says "worship" for "serve". Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew wording.

decisions.choice: "les mando" / "os mando" (plural) inside a singular sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns plural for "commanding you" only; Literal and Balanced keep the switch with a plural_you span. Readable, a single plain command, keeps "tú" throughout.

decisions.choice: "je vous commande" (plural) inside a singular sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "you" in the singular for the one who turns aside but in the plural for those Moses commands; Literal and Balanced keep the switch. Readable, a single plain command, keeps the singular throughout.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־הַקְּלָל֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if not you listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God, to keep to do all his commandments and his statutes which I [am] commanding you today, and will come on you all the curses these and overtake you.

en.L: And it will be, if you do not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, taking care to do all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes that I am commanding you today, that all these curses will come upon you and overtake you.
en.B: But if you do not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and carefully keep all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments and statutes that I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and catch up with you.
en.R: But if you do not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and you are not careful to do all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands and laws that I am giving you today, all these curses will come to you. They will follow you and find you.

es.L: Y sucederá que, si no escuchas la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, cuidando de poner por obra todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos que yo te mando hoy, vendrán sobre ti todas estas maldiciones y te alcanzarán.
es.B: Pero si no obedeces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios ni cumples con cuidado todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y estatutos que hoy te doy, todas estas maldiciones vendrán sobre ti y te darán alcance.
es.R: Pero si no obedeces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y no procuras cumplir todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y leyes que hoy te doy, todas estas maldiciones vendrán a ti. Te seguirán hasta encontrarte.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, si tu n’écoutes pas la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, en veillant à pratiquer tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions que je te commande aujourd’hui, que toutes ces malédictions viendront sur toi et t’atteindront.
fr.B: Mais si tu n’obéis pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu ne veilles pas à mettre en pratique tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions que je te donne aujourd’hui, toutes ces malédictions viendront sur toi et te rattraperont.
fr.R: Mais si tu n’obéis pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et si tu ne fais pas attention à faire tout ce que demandent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois, ceux que je te donne aujourd’hui, toutes ces malédictions viendront à toi. Elles te suivront jusqu’à te trouver.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, usipoisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ukijali kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokuamuru leo, laana hizi zote zitakuja juu yako na kukupata.
sw.B: Lakini usipomtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuzishika kwa uangalifu amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokupa leo, laana hizi zote zitakujia na kukufikia.
sw.R: Lakini usipomtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na usipokuwa mwangalifu kutenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote na sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokupa leo, laana hizi zote zitakujia. Zitakufuata mpaka zikupate.

decisions.choice: if you do not listen: the other way, matching verse 1
decisions.reason: The verse mirrors verses 1-2 word for word, with "not" added and "curses" in place of "blessings". The curses that follow answer the blessings line for line (verses 16-19 match verses 3-6) and then go on far longer.

decisions.choice: overtake: as in verse 2
decisions.reason: The curses, like the blessings, are pictured as pursuing Israel until they catch it.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the verse with "and". Balanced and Readable say "But", since the verse turns from blessing to curse; Literal keeps "And".

source.text: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursed [are] you in the city, and cursed [are] you in the field.

en.L: Cursed [are] you in the city, and cursed [are] you in the field.
en.B: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the countryside.
en.R: You will be cursed in town and in the country.

es.L: Maldito [eres] tú en la ciudad, y maldito [eres] tú en el campo.
es.B: Serás maldecido en la ciudad y maldecido en el campo.
es.R: Tendrás maldición en la ciudad y en el campo.

fr.L: Maudit [es]-tu dans la ville, et maudit [es]-tu dans les champs.
fr.B: Tu seras maudit à la ville et maudit à la campagne.
fr.R: Tu seras maudit en ville comme à la campagne.

sw.L: Umelaaniwa wewe mjini, na umelaaniwa wewe shambani.
sw.B: Utalaaniwa ukiwa mjini, na utalaaniwa ukiwa shambani.
sw.R: Utalaaniwa mjini na vijijini.

decisions.choice: Cursed are you: the reverse of verse 3
decisions.reason: The line is verse 3 with "cursed" in place of "blessed", and is worded the same way at every level.

source.text: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursed [is] your basket and your kneading bowl.

en.L: Cursed [is] your basket and your kneading bowl.
en.B: Cursed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.
en.R: The basket you gather your harvest in and the bowl you make bread in will be cursed.

es.L: Maldita [es] tu canasta y tu artesa.
es.B: Malditas serán tu canasta y tu artesa.
es.R: La canasta en que recoges tu cosecha y la vasija en que amasas tu pan serán maldecidas.

fr.L: Maudits [sont] ton panier et ton pétrin.
fr.B: Maudits seront ton panier et ton pétrin.
fr.R: Le panier où tu ranges ta récolte et le bol où tu pétris ton pain seront maudits.

sw.L: Kimelaaniwa kikapu chako na chombo chako cha kukandia unga.
sw.B: Vitalaaniwa kikapu chako na chombo chako cha kukandia unga.
sw.R: Kikapu unachokusanyia mavuno yako na bakuli unalokandia unga wa mkate vitalaaniwa.

decisions.choice: basket and kneading bowl: as in verse 5
decisions.reason: The harvest and the bread made from it will fail. The wording follows verse 5 at every level.

source.text: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursed [is the] fruit of your womb and [the] fruit of your ground, [the] young of your cattle and [the] young of your flock.

en.L: Cursed [is] the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, the offspring of your cattle and the young of your flock.
en.B: Cursed will be the children you bear, the harvest of your soil, and the young of your cattle and your sheep.
en.R: Your children will be cursed, and your crops, and the calves in your herds and the lambs in your flocks.

es.L: Maldito [es] el fruto de tu vientre, y el fruto de tu suelo, la cría de tus vacas y las crías de tus ovejas.
es.B: Malditos serán los hijos que tengas, la cosecha de tu suelo, y las crías de tus vacas y de tus ovejas.
es.R: Tus hijos serán maldecidos, y también tus cosechas, los terneros de tus manadas y los corderos de tus rebaños.

fr.L: Maudit [est] le fruit de ton sein, et le fruit de ton sol, la portée de tes vaches et les petits de ton petit bétail.
fr.B: Maudits seront les enfants que tu mettras au monde, la récolte de ton sol, et les petits de tes vaches et de tes brebis.
fr.R: Tes enfants seront maudits, ainsi que tes récoltes, les veaux de tes troupeaux et les agneaux de tes moutons.

sw.L: Limelaaniwa tunda la tumbo lako, na tunda la ardhi yako, uzao wa ng'ombe wako na wadogo wa kundi lako la kondoo.
sw.B: Watalaaniwa watoto utakaowazaa, na mavuno ya ardhi yako, na ndama wa ng'ombe wako na wana-kondoo wa kondoo wako.
sw.R: Watoto wako watalaaniwa, pamoja na mazao yako, na ndama katika makundi yako ya ng'ombe na wana-kondoo katika makundi yako ya kondoo.

decisions.choice: fruit of your womb and of your ground: as in verse 4
decisions.reason: Children and crops, as in verse 4. This line leaves out "the fruit of your livestock" but goes on to name the young of the herds and flocks, so the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: same wording as verse 4
decisions.reason: Each level uses the wording of verse 4, so the curse is heard as the exact reverse of the blessing.

source.text: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursed [are] you in your coming in, and cursed [are] you in your going out.

en.L: Cursed [are] you in your coming in, and cursed [are] you in your going out.
en.B: You will be cursed as you come in and cursed as you go out.
en.R: You will be cursed when you come in and when you go out, in everything you do.

es.L: Maldito [eres] tú en tu entrar, y maldito [eres] tú en tu salir.
es.B: Serás maldecido al entrar y maldecido al salir.
es.R: Tendrás maldición cuando entres y cuando salgas, en todo lo que hagas.

fr.L: Maudit [es]-tu à ton entrée, et maudit [es]-tu à ta sortie.
fr.B: Tu seras maudit quand tu entreras et maudit quand tu sortiras.
fr.R: Tu seras maudit quand tu rentreras et quand tu sortiras, dans tout ce que tu feras.

sw.L: Umelaaniwa wewe katika kuingia kwako, na umelaaniwa wewe katika kutoka kwako.
sw.B: Utalaaniwa unapoingia na utalaaniwa unapotoka.
sw.R: Utalaaniwa unaporudi nyumbani na unapotoka, katika kila jambo unalofanya.

decisions.choice: coming in and going out: as in verse 6
decisions.reason: All of daily life will be under the curse. The wording follows verse 6 at every level.

source.text: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀בְּ֠ךָ אֶת־הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת־הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל־מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד־אֲבָדְךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Will send Yahweh on you the curse, the confusion and the rebuke in all [the] undertaking of your hand which you do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of [the] evil of your deeds by which you have forsaken me.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send on you the curse, the confusion and the rebuke in all the undertaking of your hand that you do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your deeds, in that you have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send on you curse, panic and frustration in everything you set your hand to, until you are destroyed and quickly perish, because of the evil you have done in forsaking {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send curses, panic and failure on everything you try to do, until you are destroyed. You will soon be gone, because you did evil and turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará sobre ti la maldición, la confusión y la reprensión en toda empresa de tu mano que hagas, hasta que seas destruido y hasta que perezcas pronto, a causa de la maldad de tus obras, por las cuales {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has abandonado.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará sobre ti maldición, pánico y fracaso en todo lo que emprendas, hasta que seas destruido y perezcas pronto, por el mal que has hecho al abandonarme.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará maldiciones, pánico y fracaso sobre todo lo que intentes hacer, hasta que seas destruido. Pronto desaparecerás, porque hiciste el mal y te apartaste de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra sur toi la malédiction, la panique et la réprimande dans toute entreprise de ta main que tu feras, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit et jusqu’à ce que tu périsses rapidement, à cause de la méchanceté de tes actions, parce que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as abandonné.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra sur toi la malédiction, l’affolement et l’échec dans tout ce que tu entreprendras, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit et que tu périsses rapidement, à cause du mal que tu as fait en {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}abandonnant.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra des malédictions, la panique et l’échec sur tout ce que tu essaieras de faire, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit. Tu disparaîtras bientôt, parce que tu as fait le mal et que tu t’es détourné de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea laana, fadhaa na makaripio katika kila kazi ya mkono wako unayoifanya, mpaka utakapoangamizwa na mpaka utakapopotea upesi, kwa sababu ya uovu wa matendo yako, kwa kuwa umeniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea laana, hofu kuu na kushindwa katika kila unachokishughulikia, mpaka utakapoangamizwa na kupotea upesi, kwa sababu ya uovu uliotenda kwa kuniacha.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea laana, hofu kuu na kushindwa katika kila unachojaribu kufanya, mpaka utakapoangamizwa. Utatoweka upesi, kwa sababu ulitenda maovu na kuniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the curse, the confusion, the rebuke
decisions.reason: The first word is a curse that brings ruin. The second is the panic and disorder the LORD sends on his enemies (7:23; 1 Samuel 5:9). The third is a rebuke that blocks and spoils whatever is attempted, so that nothing succeeds.

decisions.choice: forsaken me: the LORD himself speaks
decisions.reason: Moses is speaking, but the words "you have forsaken me" are the LORD's. In Deuteronomy Moses' voice passes into the LORD's own without notice (7:4; 11:14-15; 17:3).

decisions.choice: the undertaking of your hand: as in verse 8
decisions.reason: The blessing on all their work in verse 8 becomes a curse on it.

decisions.choice: me, the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker, so that young readers do not take "me" to be Moses.

source.text: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּךָ֖ אֶת־הַדָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣וֹ אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will make cling Yahweh to you the pestilence until he has finished you from on the ground where you [are] going there to possess it.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make the pestilence cling to you until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has consumed you from the land that you are going into to take possession of.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make disease cling to you until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has wiped you out from the land you are entering to take possession of.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send deadly disease that will not leave you, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has wiped you out from the land you are going into to take as your own.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que se te pegue la peste hasta que te haya acabado de sobre el suelo al que entras para tomar posesión de él.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que la enfermedad mortal se te pegue hasta que te haya exterminado de la tierra en la que entras para tomar posesión de ella.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará una enfermedad mortal que no te dejará, hasta que te haya exterminado de la tierra en la que vas a entrar para tomarla como tuya.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera s’attacher à toi la peste, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait achevé de dessus le sol où tu entres pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera s’attacher à toi la maladie mortelle, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait fait disparaître du pays où tu entres pour en prendre possession.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra une maladie mortelle qui ne te quittera pas, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait fait disparaître du pays où tu vas entrer pour le prendre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifanya tauni ishikamane nawe mpaka atakapokumaliza katika ardhi unayoiingia ili kuimiliki.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataufanya ugonjwa wa kuua ushikamane nawe mpaka atakapokufutilia mbali kutoka katika nchi unayoiingia ili kuimiliki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea ugonjwa wa kuua ambao hautakuacha, mpaka atakapokufutilia mbali kutoka katika nchi unayoiingia ili uichukue iwe yako.

decisions.choice: the pestilence: a deadly epidemic
decisions.reason: The word names a plague that kills many, among people or animals (Exodus 9:3, 15; Leviticus 26:25).

decisions.choice: consumed: finished off, brought to an end
decisions.reason: The verb means to complete or finish, and so to destroy entirely.

decisions.choice: take possession of (Balanced); take as your own (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase about the land comes back in verse 63 and is worded the same way there at each level.

source.text: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּבַיֵּרָק֑וֹן וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will strike you Yahweh with consumption and with fever and with inflammation and with fiery heat and with sword and with blight and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with wasting disease and with fever and with inflammation and with fiery heat and with sword and with blight and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with wasting disease, fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and the sword, with blight and mildew. They will hunt you down until you perish.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with diseases that make you waste away, with fever and swelling. He will send burning heat and war, and diseases that ruin your crops. These troubles will chase you until you die.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con consunción, y con fiebre, y con inflamación, y con calor ardiente, y con espada, y con tizón, y con añublo, y te perseguirán hasta que perezcas.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con enfermedades que consumen, fiebre e inflamación, con calor abrasador y espada, con tizón y añublo. Te perseguirán hasta que perezcas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con enfermedades que te consumirán, con fiebre y con hinchazones. Enviará calor abrasador y guerra, y enfermedades que arruinarán tus cosechas. Estas desgracias te perseguirán hasta que mueras.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera de consomption, et de fièvre, et d’inflammation, et de chaleur brûlante, et d’épée, et de brûlure, et de rouille, et elles te poursuivront jusqu’à ce que tu périsses.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera de consomption, de fièvre et d’inflammation, de chaleur desséchante et d’épée, de brûlure et de rouille des blés. Elles te traqueront jusqu’à ce que tu périsses.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera de maladies qui te feront dépérir, de fièvre et d’enflures. Il enverra une chaleur brûlante et la guerre, et des maladies qui abîmeront tes récoltes. Ces malheurs te poursuivront jusqu’à ta mort.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa ugonjwa wa kukondesha, na kwa homa, na kwa uvimbe, na kwa joto kali, na kwa upanga, na kwa ukaukaji, na kwa ukungu, navyo vitakufuatia mpaka uangamie.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa ugonjwa wa kukondesha, homa na uvimbe, kwa joto kali na upanga, kwa ukaukaji na ukungu wa nafaka. Vitakuwinda mpaka uangamie.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa magonjwa yatakayokukondesha, kwa homa na uvimbe. Atatuma joto kali na vita, na magonjwa yatakayoharibu mazao yako. Taabu hizi zitakufukuza mpaka ufe.

decisions.choice: wasting disease, fever, inflammation, fiery heat
decisions.reason: These are names of diseases, probably a sickness that wastes the body, a burning fever, an inflammation and a feverish heat. Exactly which illnesses they were cannot be known. The first two also appear in Leviticus 26:16.

decisions.choice: sword
decisions.reason: The written consonants can be read with different vowels as "drought", which would fit the heat before it and the crop diseases after it. Some ancient translations read it that way. The Hebrew text as pointed reads "sword", and this translation follows it.

decisions.choice: blight and mildew: diseases of grain
decisions.reason: Blight is the scorching of grain by the hot east wind; mildew is a disease that turns the ears yellow. They are named together in 1 Kings 8:37 and Amos 4:9.

decisions.choice: war; diseases that ruin your crops
decisions.reason: Readable says "war" for the sword and explains blight and mildew as crop diseases.

source.text: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be your heavens which [are] over your head bronze, and the earth which [is] under you iron.

en.L: And your heavens that are over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you iron.
en.B: The sky above your head will be bronze, and the ground beneath you iron.
en.R: The sky above you will be hard like bronze and give no rain. The ground under you will be as hard as iron.

es.L: Y tus cielos que están sobre tu cabeza serán de bronce, y la tierra que está debajo de ti, de hierro.
es.B: El cielo sobre tu cabeza será de bronce, y el suelo bajo tus pies, de hierro.
es.R: El cielo sobre ti será duro como el bronce y no dará lluvia. La tierra bajo tus pies será tan dura como el hierro.

fr.L: Et tes cieux qui sont au-dessus de ta tête seront de bronze, et la terre qui est sous toi, de fer.
fr.B: Le ciel au-dessus de ta tête sera de bronze, et le sol sous tes pieds de fer.
fr.R: Le ciel au-dessus de toi sera dur comme du bronze et ne donnera pas de pluie. La terre sous tes pieds sera aussi dure que du fer.

sw.L: Na mbingu zako, zile zilizo juu ya kichwa chako, zitakuwa shaba, nayo ardhi iliyo chini yako, chuma.
sw.B: Anga juu ya kichwa chako itakuwa shaba, na ardhi chini ya miguu yako chuma.
sw.R: Anga juu yako itakuwa ngumu kama shaba wala haitatoa mvua. Ardhi chini yako itakuwa ngumu kama chuma.

decisions.choice: bronze sky, iron ground: drought
decisions.reason: A sky like metal gives no rain, and ground like iron cannot be ploughed or grow anything (Leviticus 26:19). It is the reverse of the opened storehouse of verse 12.

decisions.choice: and give no rain
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture.

source.text: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will make Yahweh [the] rain of your land powder and dust; from the heavens it will come down on you until you are destroyed.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make the rain of your land powder and dust; from the heavens it will come down on you until you are destroyed.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will turn the rain of your land into powder and dust; it will fall on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
en.R: Instead of rain, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send dust and sand down from the sky on your land, until you are destroyed.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará de la lluvia de tu tierra polvo fino y tierra; de los cielos descenderá sobre ti hasta que seas destruido.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cambiará la lluvia de tu tierra en polvo y tierra; caerá del cielo sobre ti hasta que seas destruido.
es.R: En lugar de lluvia, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará caer del cielo polvo y arena sobre tu tierra, hasta que seas destruido.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera de la pluie de ton pays de la poudre et de la poussière ; des cieux elle descendra sur toi jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} changera la pluie de ton pays en poudre et en poussière ; elle tombera du ciel sur toi jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.
fr.R: Au lieu de la pluie, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera tomber du ciel sur ton pays de la poussière et du sable, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifanya mvua ya nchi yako kuwa mavumbi laini na udongo; kutoka angani itashuka juu yako mpaka uangamizwe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataigeuza mvua ya nchi yako kuwa mavumbi na udongo; yatakuangukia kutoka angani mpaka uangamizwe.
sw.R: Badala ya mvua, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atashusha kutoka angani vumbi na mchanga juu ya nchi yako, mpaka uangamizwe.

decisions.choice: powder and dust instead of rain: dust storms
decisions.reason: In a drought the hot wind from the desert fills the air with fine dust, which falls where rain should have fallen.

decisions.choice: Instead of rain
decisions.reason: Readable puts the contrast first, so the picture is clear.

source.text: יִתֶּנְךָ֨יְהוָ֥ה׀נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will make you Yahweh defeated before your enemies; by way one you will go out against him, and by seven ways you will flee before him, and you will become a horror to all [the] kingdoms of the earth.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you defeated before your enemies; by one way you will go out against them, and by seven ways you will flee before them, and you will become a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will let your enemies defeat you. You will march out against them by one road and flee from them by seven. You will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will let your enemies defeat you. You will come at them from one direction, but you will run away from them in seven directions. All the kingdoms on earth will be horrified at what has happened to you.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que seas derrotado delante de tus enemigos; por un camino saldrás contra ellos, y por siete caminos huirás delante de ellos, y serás objeto de espanto para todos los reinos de la tierra.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejará que tus enemigos te derroten. Saldrás contra ellos por un camino y huirás de ellos por siete. Serás motivo de horror para todos los reinos de la tierra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejará que tus enemigos te venzan. Vendrás contra ellos desde una dirección, pero huirás de ellos en siete direcciones. Todos los reinos de la tierra se horrorizarán de lo que te habrá pasado.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te rendra battu devant tes ennemis ; par un seul chemin tu sortiras contre eux, et par sept chemins tu fuiras devant eux, et tu deviendras un objet d’effroi pour tous les royaumes de la terre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} laissera tes ennemis te battre. Tu marcheras contre eux par une seule route et tu t’enfuiras devant eux par sept. Tu deviendras un objet d’horreur pour tous les royaumes de la terre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} laissera tes ennemis te vaincre. Tu viendras contre eux d’un seul côté, mais tu t’enfuiras devant eux dans sept directions. Tous les royaumes de la terre seront horrifiés de ce qui te sera arrivé.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya upigwe mbele ya adui zako; kwa njia moja utatoka dhidi yao, na kwa njia saba utakimbia mbele yao, nawe utakuwa kitisho kwa falme zote za dunia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaacha adui zako wakushinde. Utawajia kwa njia moja na kuwakimbia kwa njia saba. Utakuwa kitu cha kutisha kwa falme zote za dunia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaacha adui zako wakushinde. Utawajia kutoka upande mmoja, lakini utawakimbia pande saba. Falme zote duniani zitashtuka sana kwa yale yatakayokupata.

decisions.choice: one way, seven ways: verse 7 turned around
decisions.reason: The words of verse 7 come back with Israel and its enemies changing places.

decisions.choice: a horror: something that makes people shudder
decisions.reason: The word means a terror or object of dread; others see what has happened to Israel and are shaken (Jeremiah 15:4; 24:9).

decisions.choice: them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "him", the enemy as one body. English says "them" at every level, so the pronoun is not taken for one person.

source.text: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל־ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be your corpse food for every bird of the heavens and for [the] animals of the earth, and there [will be] none frightening [them].

en.L: And your corpses will be food for every bird of the sky and for the animals of the earth, and [there will be] no one to frighten [them] away.
en.B: Your dead bodies will be food for all the birds of the sky and the wild animals, and no one will frighten them away.
en.R: Your dead bodies will be eaten by birds and wild animals, and no one will be there to chase them away.

es.L: Y tus cadáveres serán comida para toda ave del cielo y para las bestias de la tierra, y [no habrá] nadie que [las] espante.
es.B: Tus cadáveres serán alimento de todas las aves del cielo y de las fieras, y nadie las espantará.
es.R: Las aves y los animales salvajes se comerán tus cadáveres, y no habrá nadie que los ahuyente.

fr.L: Et tes cadavres seront la nourriture de tout oiseau du ciel et des bêtes de la terre, et [il n’y aura] personne pour [les] effrayer.
fr.B: Tes cadavres serviront de nourriture à tous les oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes sauvages, et personne ne les chassera.
fr.R: Les oiseaux et les bêtes sauvages mangeront tes morts, et personne ne sera là pour les chasser.

sw.L: Na maiti zako zitakuwa chakula cha kila ndege wa angani na cha wanyama wa nchi, wala [hapatakuwa na] mtu wa kuwafukuza.
sw.B: Maiti zako zitakuwa chakula cha ndege wote wa angani na wanyama wa porini, wala hakuna atakayewafukuza.
sw.R: Ndege na wanyama wa porini watakula maiti zako, wala hakutakuwa na mtu wa kuwafukuza.

decisions.choice: food for the birds: left unburied
decisions.reason: To lie unburied, eaten by birds and animals, was the worst disgrace that could come to the dead (1 Samuel 17:44; 2 Samuel 21:10; Jeremiah 7:33).

decisions.choice: your corpse: the dead of the whole people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular, but it speaks of the dead of the nation as a whole.

decisions.choice: corpses, dead bodies
decisions.reason: English uses the plural for the Hebrew collective singular.

source.text: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וּבַטְּחֹרִ֔ים וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Will strike you Yahweh with [the] boil of Egypt and with tumors and with scabs and with itch, which not you will be able to be healed.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors and with scabs and with itch, from which you will not be able to be healed.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors, scabs and itch that cannot be cured.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with the same sores {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent on Egypt, and with swellings and itching skin diseases that cannot be healed.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con las úlceras de Egipto, y con tumores, y con costras, y con comezón, de los que no podrás ser sanado.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con las úlceras de Egipto, con tumores, costras y comezón que no se podrán curar.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con las mismas llagas que envió sobre Egipto, y con hinchazones y enfermedades de la piel que pican y no se pueden curar.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera des ulcères d’Égypte, et de tumeurs, et de croûtes, et de démangeaison, dont tu ne pourras pas guérir.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera des ulcères d’Égypte, de tumeurs, de croûtes et de démangeaisons qu’on ne pourra pas guérir.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera des mêmes plaies qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyées sur l’Égypte, et d’enflures et de maladies de peau qui démangent et que l’on ne pourra pas guérir.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa majipu ya Misri, na kwa vivimbe, na kwa vigaga, na kwa muwasho, ambavyo hutaweza kuponywa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa majipu ya Misri, kwa vivimbe, vigaga na muwasho usioweza kuponywa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa vidonda vilevile alivyowaletea Wamisri, na kwa uvimbe na magonjwa ya ngozi yanayowasha yasiyoweza kuponywa.

decisions.choice: the boils of Egypt: the sixth plague
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the boils that broke out on the Egyptians and their animals (Exodus 9:9-11). What the LORD did to Egypt he will do to Israel (verse 60).

decisions.choice: tumors
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell a word that means swellings, perhaps of the bowel. A note in the margin, followed in reading aloud, gives another word with the same meaning that was felt to be less coarse. The same exchange is made in 1 Samuel 5:6-12. This translation follows the word that is read; the sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: scabs and itch: skin diseases
decisions.reason: Both words name skin diseases that cause scabs and itching (Leviticus 21:20; 22:22). Which ones exactly is not known.

decisions.choice: the same sores he sent on Egypt; swellings and itching skin diseases
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the boils of Egypt" and uses common words for the diseases.

source.text: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Will strike you Yahweh with madness and with blindness and with bewilderment of heart.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with madness and with blindness and with bewilderment of heart.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you go mad and blind, and your mind will be confused.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con locura, y con ceguera, y con desvarío de corazón.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con locura, ceguera y confusión mental.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que te vuelvas loco y ciego, y tu mente estará confundida.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera de folie, et d’aveuglement, et d’égarement de cœur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera de folie, d’aveuglement et de confusion d’esprit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te rendra fou et aveugle, et ton esprit sera troublé.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa kichaa, na kwa upofu, na kwa kuchanganyikiwa moyo.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa kichaa, upofu na kuchanganyikiwa akili.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya uwe kichaa na kipofu, na akili yako itachanganyikiwa.

decisions.choice: bewilderment of heart: confusion of mind
