decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought in Hebrew. The phrase describes a panic so great that people cannot think. The same three words come together of horses and riders in battle in Zechariah 12:4.

decisions.choice: blindness: of the eyes and of the mind
decisions.reason: The word may mean loss of sight, but beside madness and confusion, and with verse 29, it also describes people who cannot see what to do.

decisions.choice: mind
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "mind" for "heart", since the word here is about thinking.

source.text: וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כָּל־הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will be groping at noon just as gropes the blind [man] in darkness, and not you will make prosper your ways; and you will be only oppressed and robbed all the days, and there [will be] none saving.

en.L: And you will be groping at noon as {{gender:the blind person|the blind man}} gropes in the darkness, and you will not make your ways prosper; and you will be only oppressed and robbed all the days, and [there will be] no one to save [you].
en.B: At noon you will grope like a blind person groping in the dark, and you will not succeed in anything you do. You will be nothing but oppressed and robbed all the time, and no one will come to save you.
en.R: Even at midday you will feel your way around like a blind person in the dark. Nothing you do will succeed. People will always be mistreating you and robbing you, and no one will rescue you.

es.L: Y andarás a tientas al mediodía, como anda a tientas {{gender:la persona ciega|el ciego}} en la oscuridad, y no harás prosperar tus caminos; y serás solamente oprimido y despojado todos los días, y [no habrá] nadie que [te] salve.
es.B: Al mediodía andarás a tientas como una persona ciega que tantea en la oscuridad, y no tendrás éxito en nada de lo que hagas. No serás más que oprimido y despojado todo el tiempo, y nadie vendrá a salvarte.
es.R: Aun al mediodía irás tanteando como una persona ciega en la oscuridad. Nada de lo que hagas te saldrá bien. Siempre habrá gente que te maltrate y te robe, y nadie te rescatará.

fr.L: Et tu iras à tâtons en plein midi, comme l’aveugle tâtonne dans l’obscurité, et tu ne feras pas réussir tes voies ; et tu seras seulement opprimé et dépouillé tous les jours, et [il n’y aura] personne pour [te] sauver.
fr.B: En plein midi, tu tâtonneras comme un aveugle qui cherche son chemin dans le noir, et tu ne réussiras dans rien de ce que tu feras. Tu ne seras qu’opprimé et dépouillé sans cesse, et personne ne viendra te sauver.
fr.R: Même en plein jour, tu chercheras ton chemin à tâtons comme un aveugle dans le noir. Rien de ce que tu feras ne réussira. On te maltraitera et on te volera tout le temps, et personne ne te délivrera.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa ukipapasa saa sita mchana kama kipofu anavyopapasa katika giza, wala hutazifanya njia zako zifanikiwe; utakuwa ukidhulumiwa tu na kuporwa siku zote, wala [hakuna] wa [kukuokoa].
sw.B: Mchana kweupe utapapasa kama kipofu anayepapasa gizani, wala hutafanikiwa katika lolote unalofanya. Hutakuwa kitu ila mtu anayedhulumiwa na kuporwa wakati wote, wala hakuna atakayekuja kukuokoa.
sw.R: Hata saa sita mchana utatembea kwa kupapasa kama kipofu gizani. Hakuna kitu utakachofanya kitakachofanikiwa. Watu watakuwa wakikutendea mabaya na kukuibia daima, wala hakuna atakayekuokoa.

decisions.choice: groping at noon: helpless even in full daylight
decisions.reason: Even when the light is brightest, they will feel their way like the blind. It carries on the blindness of mind in verse 28 (Isaiah 59:10).

decisions.choice: oppressed and robbed: cheated and plundered
decisions.reason: The two words are paired in Leviticus 19:13 for wronging a neighbor by force or fraud. Here others will do it to Israel without end. Verse 33 has a similar line.

decisions.choice: you will not make your ways prosper: nothing you do will succeed
decisions.reason: "Ways" are a person's undertakings, and "make prosper" means bring to success.

decisions.choice: the blind person / the blind man
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a masculine form used for any blind person, so Literal gives an inclusive default with the traditional form as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "l'aveugle" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: French "l'aveugle" already covers a blind man or woman, so the English Literal's gender span has nothing to change in French.

source.text: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ יִשְׁכָּבֶ֔נָּה בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא־תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A woman you will betroth, and a man another will lie with her; a house you will build, and not you will dwell in it; a vineyard you will plant, and not you will make common use of it.

en.L: A woman you will betroth, and another man will lie with her; a house you will build, and you will not live in it; a vineyard you will plant, and you will not put it to use.
en.B: You will be engaged to a woman, but another man will sleep with her. You will build a house but not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but never enjoy its fruit.
en.R: You will be engaged to marry a woman, but another man will take her and sleep with her. You will build a house, but you will never live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will never eat its grapes.

es.L: Con una mujer te desposarás, y otro hombre se acostará con ella; una casa edificarás, y no habitarás en ella; una viña plantarás, y no la pondrás en uso.
es.B: Estarás comprometido con una mujer, pero otro hombre dormirá con ella. Construirás una casa, pero no vivirás en ella. Plantarás una viña, pero nunca disfrutarás de su fruto.
es.R: Estarás comprometido para casarte con una mujer, pero otro hombre te la quitará y dormirá con ella. Construirás una casa, pero nunca vivirás en ella. Plantarás una viña, pero nunca comerás sus uvas.

fr.L: Une femme tu fianceras, et un autre homme couchera avec elle ; une maison tu bâtiras, et tu n’y habiteras pas ; une vigne tu planteras, et tu n’en feras pas usage.
fr.B: Tu seras fiancé à une femme, mais c’est un autre homme qui couchera avec elle. Tu construiras une maison sans jamais y habiter. Tu planteras une vigne sans jamais profiter de ses fruits.
fr.R: Tu seras fiancé à une femme, mais un autre homme la prendra et couchera avec elle. Tu construiras une maison, mais tu n’y habiteras jamais. Tu planteras une vigne, mais tu n’en mangeras jamais le raisin.

sw.L: Mwanamke utamposa, na mwanamume mwingine atalala naye; nyumba utaijenga, wala hutakaa ndani yake; shamba la mizabibu utalipanda, wala hutalitumia.
sw.B: Utamchumbia mwanamke, lakini mwanamume mwingine atalala naye. Utajenga nyumba lakini hutaishi ndani yake. Utapanda shamba la mizabibu lakini hutafurahia matunda yake kamwe.
sw.R: Utamchumbia mwanamke ili umwoe, lakini mwanamume mwingine atamchukua na kulala naye. Utajenga nyumba, lakini hutaishi ndani yake kamwe. Utapanda shamba la mizabibu, lakini hutakula zabibu zake kamwe.

decisions.choice: betrothed wife, new house, new vineyard: the things that excused a man from war
decisions.reason: In 20:5-7 a man who had built a new house, planted a vineyard or become engaged was sent home from battle so that he would not die and leave them to another. Here the curse takes all three from him while he lives.

decisions.choice: lie with her
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text give a coarser verb for sex. A note in the margin, followed in reading aloud, gives "lie with her" instead, as also in Isaiah 13:16, Jeremiah 3:2 and Zechariah 14:2. The meaning is the same; the woman is taken by force.

decisions.choice: put it to use: begin to eat its fruit
decisions.reason: The verb means to make common, to bring into ordinary use. The fruit of a new vineyard could not be eaten for its first years (Leviticus 19:23-25); the owner who has waited will never get to enjoy it (20:6).

decisions.choice: enjoy its fruit (Balanced); eat its grapes (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what putting a vineyard to use means; Literal keeps "put it to use".

source.text: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your ox [will be] slaughtered before your eyes, and not you will eat of it; your donkey [will be] robbed from before you, and not it will return to you; your flock [will be] given to your enemies, and there [will be] none for you saving.

en.L: Your ox [will be] slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it; your donkey [will be] robbed from before you, and it will not come back to you; your flock [will be] given to your enemies, and [there will be] no one to save you.
en.B: Your ox will be slaughtered in front of you, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be seized from you by force and never returned. Your sheep will be handed over to your enemies, and no one will come to save you.
en.R: Your ox will be killed while you watch, but you will not get to eat any of it. Your donkey will be stolen right in front of you, and you will never get it back. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue you.

es.L: Tu buey [será] degollado ante tus ojos, pero no comerás de él; tu asno [será] arrebatado de delante de ti, y no volverá a ti; tus ovejas [serán] entregadas a tus enemigos, y [no habrá] nadie que te salve.
es.B: Tu buey será sacrificado delante de ti, pero no comerás nada de él. Tu asno te será quitado por la fuerza y nunca te lo devolverán. Tus ovejas serán entregadas a tus enemigos, y nadie vendrá a salvarte.
es.R: Matarán tu buey mientras tú miras, pero no podrás comer nada de él. Te robarán el asno delante de ti, y nunca lo recuperarás. Tus ovejas serán dadas a tus enemigos, y nadie te rescatará.

fr.L: Ton bœuf [sera] égorgé sous tes yeux, mais tu n’en mangeras pas ; ton âne [sera] enlevé de devant toi, et il ne te reviendra pas ; ton petit bétail [sera] livré à tes ennemis, et [il n’y aura] personne pour te sauver.
fr.B: Ton bœuf sera abattu sous tes yeux, mais tu n’en mangeras rien. Ton âne te sera arraché de force et ne te sera jamais rendu. Tes moutons seront livrés à tes ennemis, et personne ne viendra te sauver.
fr.R: On tuera ton bœuf pendant que tu regardes, mais tu n’en mangeras pas un morceau. On volera ton âne juste devant toi, et tu ne le récupéreras jamais. Tes moutons seront donnés à tes ennemis, et personne ne te délivrera.

sw.L: Ng'ombe wako [atachinjwa] mbele ya macho yako, wala hutakula nyama yake; punda wako [atanyang'anywa] mbele yako, wala hatarudi kwako; kondoo wako [watapewa] adui zako, wala [hakuna] mtu wa kukuokoa.
sw.B: Ng'ombe wako atachinjwa mbele yako, lakini hutakula hata kidogo. Punda wako atanyang'anywa kwa nguvu na hatarudishwa kwako kamwe. Kondoo wako watatiwa mikononi mwa adui zako, wala hakuna atakayekuja kukuokoa.
sw.R: Ng'ombe wako atauawa ukiwa unatazama, lakini hutapata kula chochote. Punda wako ataibwa mbele yako, nawe hutampata tena. Kondoo wako watapewa adui zako, wala hakuna atakayekuokoa.

decisions.choice: robbed: seized by force
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for "robbed" in verse 29: taken openly by someone stronger.

decisions.choice: ox, donkey and flock: the wealth of a farming household
decisions.reason: The ox pulled the plough, the donkey carried loads, and the flock gave milk, wool and meat. Losing them meant losing the means to live.

source.text: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְכָל֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your sons and your daughters [will be] given to a people another, and your eyes [will be] looking and failing for them all the day, and there [will be] no power of your hand.

en.L: Your sons and your daughters [will be] given to another people, and your eyes [will be] looking and failing for them all the day, and [there will be] no power in your hand.
en.B: Your sons and daughters will be handed over to another people while you look on. Your eyes will wear themselves out longing for them all day long, and you will be powerless to do anything.
en.R: Your sons and daughters will be given to foreigners, and you will watch it happen. Every day you will look for them and long for them until your eyes grow tired, but you will be able to do nothing.

es.L: Tus hijos y tus hijas [serán] entregados a otro pueblo, y tus ojos [estarán] mirando y desfalleciendo por ellos todo el día, y [no habrá] fuerza en tu mano.
es.B: Tus hijos e hijas serán entregados a otro pueblo mientras tú miras. Tus ojos se cansarán de anhelarlos todo el día, y no podrás hacer nada.
es.R: Tus hijos y tus hijas serán dados a extranjeros, y tú verás cómo sucede. Cada día los buscarás con la mirada y los añorarás hasta que se te cansen los ojos, pero no podrás hacer nada.

fr.L: Tes fils et tes filles [seront] livrés à un autre peuple, et tes yeux [seront] à regarder et à se consumer pour eux tout le jour, et [il n’y aura] pas de force dans ta main.
fr.B: Tes fils et tes filles seront livrés à un autre peuple sous tes yeux. Tes yeux s’useront à les attendre toute la journée, et tu seras impuissant.
fr.R: Tes fils et tes filles seront donnés à des étrangers, et tu verras cela arriver. Chaque jour, tu les chercheras du regard et tu les attendras jusqu’à en avoir les yeux fatigués, mais tu ne pourras rien faire.

sw.L: Wana wako na binti zako [watapewa] watu wengine, na macho yako [yatakuwa] yakitazama na kufifia kwa ajili yao mchana kutwa, wala [hakutakuwa na] nguvu mkononi mwako.
sw.B: Wana wako na binti zako watatolewa kwa watu wengine ukiwa unatazama. Macho yako yatachoka kwa kuwatamani mchana kutwa, wala hutakuwa na uwezo wa kufanya lolote.
sw.R: Wana wako na binti zako watapewa wageni, nawe utaona ikitokea. Kila siku utawatafuta kwa macho na kuwatamani mpaka macho yako yachoke, lakini hutaweza kufanya chochote.

decisions.choice: eyes looking and failing: worn out with longing
decisions.reason: The eyes "fail" or wear out from watching for someone who does not come (Psalm 69:4; Lamentations 4:17). Parents will watch their children taken away and look for their return in vain.

decisions.choice: no power in your hand: helpless
decisions.reason: The phrase means there is nothing one can do. It is used of parents whose children are sold into slavery in Nehemiah 5:5 (see also Genesis 31:29; Micah 2:1).

decisions.choice: while you look on (Balanced); you will watch it happen (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your eyes looking" before "failing". Balanced and Readable put the watching with the giving away, then the longing in a sentence of its own.

source.text: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל־יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] fruit of your ground and all your toil will eat a people which not you have known, and you will be only oppressed and crushed all the days.

en.L: The fruit of your ground and all your toil a people whom you have not known will eat, and you will be only oppressed and crushed all the days.
en.B: A people you have never known will eat up the harvest of your soil and everything you have worked for, and you will be nothing but oppressed and crushed all the time.
en.R: Foreigners you have never heard of will eat your crops and everything you worked hard for. People will always be mistreating you and crushing you.

es.L: El fruto de tu suelo y todo tu trabajo, un pueblo que no has conocido [lo] comerá, y serás solamente oprimido y quebrantado todos los días.
es.B: Un pueblo que nunca has conocido se comerá la cosecha de tu suelo y todo el fruto de tu trabajo, y no serás más que oprimido y aplastado todo el tiempo.
es.R: Extranjeros de los que nunca has oído hablar se comerán tus cosechas y todo lo que te costó tanto trabajo. Siempre habrá gente que te maltrate y te aplaste.

fr.L: Le fruit de ton sol et tout ton labeur, un peuple que tu n’as pas connu le mangera, et tu seras seulement opprimé et écrasé tous les jours.
fr.B: Un peuple que tu n’as jamais connu mangera la récolte de ton sol et tout le fruit de ton travail, et tu ne seras qu’opprimé et écrasé sans cesse.
fr.R: Des étrangers dont tu n’as jamais entendu parler mangeront tes récoltes et tout ce que tu as gagné par ton travail. On te maltraitera et on t’écrasera tout le temps.

sw.L: Tunda la ardhi yako na kazi yako yote, watu usiowajua watakula, nawe utakuwa ukidhulumiwa tu na kupondwa siku zote.
sw.B: Watu ambao hujawahi kuwajua watakula mavuno ya ardhi yako na yote uliyoyatolea jasho, nawe hutakuwa kitu ila mtu anayedhulumiwa na kupondwa wakati wote.
sw.R: Wageni ambao hujawahi kusikia habari zao watakula mazao yako na kila kitu ulichokifanyia kazi kwa bidii. Watu watakuwa wakikutendea mabaya na kukuponda daima.

decisions.choice: your toil: what your hard work has produced
decisions.reason: The word means labor and also the gain that labor brings, here the produce and goods of the farm.

decisions.choice: a people you have not known: a foreign, unfamiliar nation
decisions.reason: "Not known" means strange and foreign: a nation from far away, with no ties to Israel (verses 36 and 49).

decisions.choice: A people ... will eat up
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts what is eaten first and the eaters last; Literal keeps that order and Balanced and Readable put the subject first. The last line is worded as in verse 29.

source.text: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will be driven mad from [the] sight of your eyes which you will see.

en.L: And you will be driven mad by the sight of your eyes that you will see.
en.B: You will be driven mad by what you see with your own eyes.
en.R: What you see will drive you out of your mind.

es.L: Y enloquecerás por la visión de tus ojos que verás.
es.B: Te volverás loco por lo que verás con tus propios ojos.
es.R: Lo que veas te hará perder la razón.

fr.L: Et tu deviendras fou à cause du spectacle de tes yeux, que tu verras.
fr.B: Tu deviendras fou à cause de ce que tu verras de tes propres yeux.
fr.R: Ce que tu verras te fera perdre la raison.

sw.L: Nawe utarukwa na akili kwa sababu ya maono ya macho yako utakayoyaona.
sw.B: Utarukwa na akili kwa sababu ya yale utakayoyaona kwa macho yako mwenyewe.
sw.R: Yale utakayoyaona yatakufanya upoteze akili.

decisions.choice: driven mad: losing one's mind
decisions.reason: The word comes from the same root as "madness" in verse 28. What they see will be more than the mind can bear.

source.text: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל־הַבִּרְכַּ֨יִם֙ וְעַל־הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will strike you Yahweh with boils bad on the knees and on the legs which not you will be able to be healed, from [the] sole of your foot to your crown of head.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you with bad boils on the knees and on the legs, from which you will not be able to be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet up to the crown of your head.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will cover your knees and legs with painful sores that cannot be healed. They will spread over your whole body, from your feet to the top of your head.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá con úlceras malignas en las rodillas y en las piernas, de las que no podrás ser sanado, desde la planta de tu pie hasta la coronilla de tu cabeza.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá tus rodillas y tus piernas con úlceras dolorosas que no se podrán curar, y que se extenderán desde la planta de tus pies hasta la coronilla.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te cubrirá las rodillas y las piernas de llagas dolorosas que no se podrán sanar. Se extenderán por todo tu cuerpo, de los pies a la cabeza.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera d’ulcères mauvais sur les genoux et sur les jambes, dont tu ne pourras pas guérir, depuis la plante de ton pied jusqu’au sommet de ta tête.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera tes genoux et tes jambes d’ulcères douloureux qu’on ne pourra pas guérir, et qui s’étendront de la plante de tes pieds jusqu’au sommet de ta tête.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} couvrira tes genoux et tes jambes de plaies douloureuses qui ne pourront pas guérir. Elles s’étendront sur tout ton corps, des pieds à la tête.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga kwa majipu mabaya magotini na miguuni, ambayo hutaweza kuponywa, tangu wayo wa mguu wako hadi utosi wa kichwa chako.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayapiga magoti yako na miguu yako kwa majipu yanayouma yasiyoweza kuponywa, yakienea tangu nyayo za miguu yako hadi utosi wa kichwa chako.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafunika magoti yako na miguu yako kwa vidonda vinavyouma visivyoweza kupona. Vitaenea mwili wako wote, tangu miguuni hadi kichwani.

decisions.choice: bad boils from the sole of the foot to the crown of the head
decisions.reason: The same words describe the sores that struck Job (Job 2:7).

decisions.choice: from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head: the whole body
decisions.reason: The pair names the two ends of the body to mean all of it (Isaiah 1:6; 2 Samuel 14:25).

decisions.choice: spreading (Balanced); They will spread over your whole body (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves straight from knees and legs to the whole body. Balanced and Readable supply a word that joins the two.

source.text: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Will lead Yahweh you and your king whom you will set over you to a nation which not you have known, you and your fathers, and you will serve there gods other, wood and stone.

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will lead you and your king whom you set over you to a nation that you have not known, you and your fathers, and there you will serve other gods, wood and stone.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring you and the king you set over yourselves to a nation that neither you nor your ancestors have known. There you will serve other gods, gods of wood and stone.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take you and the king you have chosen to rule you to a nation you and your ancestors never knew. There you will worship other gods, idols made of wood and stone.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te llevará a ti y a tu rey que pongas sobre ti a una nación que no has conocido, ni tú ni tus padres, y allí servirás a otros dioses, de madera y de piedra.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te llevará a ti y al rey que hayas puesto sobre ti a una nación que ni tú ni tus antepasados conocieron. Allí servirás a otros dioses, dioses de madera y de piedra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te llevará a ti y al rey que hayas escogido para gobernarte a una nación que ni tú ni tus antepasados conocieron jamás. Allí adorarás a otros dioses, ídolos hechos de madera y de piedra.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te conduira, toi et ton roi que tu auras établi sur toi, vers une nation que tu n’as pas connue, ni toi ni tes pères, et là tu serviras d’autres dieux, du bois et de la pierre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’emmènera, toi et le roi que tu auras placé au-dessus de toi, vers une nation que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez connue. Là, tu serviras d’autres dieux, des dieux de bois et de pierre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’emmènera, toi et le roi que tu auras choisi pour te gouverner, dans une nation que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez jamais connue. Là, tu adoreras d’autres dieux, des idoles faites de bois et de pierre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupeleka wewe na mfalme wako utakayemweka juu yako kwa taifa usilolijua, wewe wala baba zako, nawe utaitumikia huko miungu mingine, ya mti na jiwe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupeleka wewe na mfalme utakayemweka juu yako kwa taifa ambalo wewe wala mababu zako hamkulijua. Huko utaitumikia miungu mingine, miungu ya mti na ya jiwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupeleka wewe na mfalme uliyemchagua akutawale kwa taifa ambalo wewe na mababu zako hamkuwahi kulijua. Huko utaabudu miungu mingine, sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa mti na jiwe.

decisions.choice: your king whom you set over you
decisions.reason: Moses has allowed that Israel may one day set a king over itself (17:14-15). That king too will be led away.

decisions.choice: lead ... to a nation: take into exile
decisions.reason: The LORD will bring them out of their own land to live in a foreign one, as captives.

decisions.choice: other gods, wood and stone: idols
decisions.reason: The gods of the nations are images made by human hands (4:28; 29:16). Those who would not serve the LORD will have to serve such gods.

decisions.choice: gods of wood and stone (Balanced); idols made of wood and stone (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that "wood and stone" describes the gods. Readable also says "worship" for "serve". Verse 64 uses the same wording.

source.text: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will become a horror, a proverb and a taunt among all the peoples where will drive you Yahweh there.

en.L: And you will become a horror, a proverb and a byword among all the peoples where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will drive you.
en.B: You will become an object of horror, a saying and a joke among all the peoples where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drives you.
en.R: In all the nations where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends you, people will be shocked at what has happened to you. They will tell stories about you and make fun of you.

es.L: Y serás objeto de horror, refrán y burla entre todos los pueblos adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te arroje.
es.B: Serás objeto de horror, de refranes y de burlas entre todos los pueblos adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te arroje.
es.R: En todas las naciones adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te envíe, la gente se espantará de lo que te habrá pasado. Contarán historias sobre ti y se burlarán de ti.

fr.L: Et tu deviendras un objet d’horreur, un proverbe et une risée parmi tous les peuples où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te chassera.
fr.B: Tu deviendras un objet d’horreur, un sujet de dictons et de moqueries parmi tous les peuples où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te chassera.
fr.R: Dans toutes les nations où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’enverra, les gens seront choqués de ce qui te sera arrivé. Ils raconteront des histoires sur toi et se moqueront de toi.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa kitu cha kushangaza, methali na dhihaka kati ya mataifa yote ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufukuzia.
sw.B: Utakuwa kitu cha kutisha, msemo na kichekesho kati ya mataifa yote ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufukuzia.
sw.R: Katika mataifa yote ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupeleka, watu watashtuka kwa yale yaliyokupata. Watasimulia habari zako na kukudhihaki.

decisions.choice: a horror: a sight that appalls
decisions.reason: The word means desolation and the shock felt by those who see it (Jeremiah 25:9, 18).

decisions.choice: a proverb and a byword: a name used in sayings and in mockery
decisions.reason: People will use Israel's name as an example of disaster in their sayings and jokes (1 Kings 9:7; Jeremiah 24:9).

decisions.choice: shocked; tell stories about you and make fun of you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the three nouns mean in sentences of their own.

source.text: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Seed much you will take out [to] the field, and little you will gather, for will consume it the locust.

en.L: Much seed you will carry out to the field, and little you will gather in, for the locust will consume it.
en.B: You will take much seed out to the field but gather little, because locusts will devour it.
en.R: You will plant a lot of seed in your fields, but you will harvest very little, because locusts will eat it.

es.L: Semilla abundante llevarás al campo, y poco recogerás, porque la langosta la devorará.
es.B: Llevarás mucha semilla al campo, pero recogerás poco, porque las langostas se la comerán.
es.R: Sembrarás mucha semilla en tus campos, pero cosecharás muy poco, porque las langostas se lo comerán.

fr.L: Beaucoup de semence tu porteras aux champs, et peu tu récolteras, car la sauterelle la dévorera.
fr.B: Tu porteras beaucoup de semence aux champs, mais tu récolteras peu, car les sauterelles la dévoreront.
fr.R: Tu sèmeras beaucoup de graines dans tes champs, mais tu ne récolteras presque rien, car les sauterelles mangeront tout.

sw.L: Mbegu nyingi utazipeleka shambani, na kidogo utakusanya, kwa maana nzige watazila.
sw.B: Utapeleka shambani mbegu nyingi, lakini mavuno yatakuwa machache, kwa sababu nzige watayala.
sw.R: Utapanda mbegu nyingi mashambani mwako, lakini utavuna kidogo sana, kwa sababu nzige watakula mimea.

decisions.choice: the locust: swarms that strip the fields
decisions.reason: Swarms of locusts could eat every green thing in a region (Exodus 10:12-15; Joel 1:4).

decisions.choice: it: the crop that grows from the seed
decisions.reason: What the locust eats is the growing grain.

source.text: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא־תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃

records.literal_gloss: Vineyards you will plant and work, and wine not you will drink and not you will gather, for will eat it the worm.

en.L: Vineyards you will plant and work, but wine you will not drink, and you will not gather [the grapes], for the worm will eat them.
en.B: You will plant vineyards and tend them, but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
en.R: You will plant vineyards and work hard in them, but you will not drink any wine or even pick the grapes, because worms will eat them.

es.L: Viñas plantarás y labrarás, pero vino no beberás, ni recogerás [las uvas], porque el gusano se las comerá.
es.B: Plantarás viñas y las cultivarás, pero no beberás el vino ni recogerás las uvas, porque los gusanos se las comerán.
es.R: Plantarás viñas y trabajarás duro en ellas, pero no beberás vino ni siquiera cosecharás las uvas, porque los gusanos se las comerán.

fr.L: Des vignes tu planteras et tu cultiveras, mais du vin tu ne boiras pas, et tu ne récolteras pas [le raisin], car le ver le mangera.
fr.B: Tu planteras des vignes et tu les cultiveras, mais tu ne boiras pas de vin et tu ne récolteras pas le raisin, car les vers le mangeront.
fr.R: Tu planteras des vignes et tu y travailleras dur, mais tu ne boiras pas de vin et tu ne cueilleras même pas le raisin, car les vers le mangeront.

sw.L: Mashamba ya mizabibu utapanda na kulima, lakini divai hutakunywa, wala hutavuna [zabibu], kwa maana funza watazila.
sw.B: Utapanda mashamba ya mizabibu na kuyatunza, lakini hutakunywa divai wala kuvuna zabibu, kwa sababu funza watazila.
sw.R: Utapanda mashamba ya mizabibu na kufanya kazi kwa bidii ndani yake, lakini hutakunywa divai wala hata kuchuma zabibu, kwa sababu funza watazila.

decisions.choice: gather: harvest the grapes
decisions.reason: The verb means to gather in and store. Here it is the grapes, and perhaps the wine made from them, that will never be gathered.

decisions.choice: the worm: a pest of vines
decisions.reason: Grubs or caterpillars that eat the buds and the fruit of the vine (Jonah 4:7).

decisions.choice: [the grapes], them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "it", the crop of the vineyard. English names the grapes.

source.text: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל־גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֨מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Olive trees will be to you in all your territory, and oil not you will anoint, for will drop off your olive.

en.L: Olive trees you will have in all your territory, but with oil you will not anoint yourself, for your olives will drop off.
en.B: You will have olive trees throughout your country but no oil to rub on your body, because your olives will drop off.
en.R: You will have olive trees all over your land, but you will have no olive oil to put on your skin, because the olives will fall off before they are ripe.

es.L: Olivos tendrás en todo tu territorio, pero con aceite no te ungirás, porque tu aceituna se caerá.
es.B: Tendrás olivos por todo tu país, pero no tendrás aceite para untarte el cuerpo, porque tus aceitunas se caerán.
es.R: Tendrás olivos por toda tu tierra, pero no tendrás aceite de oliva para ponerte en la piel, porque las aceitunas se caerán antes de madurar.

fr.L: Des oliviers tu auras dans tout ton territoire, mais d’huile tu ne t’oindras pas, car tes olives tomberont.
fr.B: Tu auras des oliviers dans tout ton pays, mais pas d’huile pour t’en frotter le corps, car tes olives tomberont.
fr.R: Tu auras des oliviers partout dans ton pays, mais tu n’auras pas d’huile d’olive à te mettre sur la peau, car les olives tomberont avant d’être mûres.

sw.L: Mizeituni utakuwa nayo katika mipaka yako yote, lakini mafuta hutajipaka, kwa maana zeituni zako zitapukutika.
sw.B: Utakuwa na mizeituni katika nchi yako yote, lakini hutapata mafuta ya kujipaka mwilini, kwa sababu zeituni zako zitapukutika.
sw.R: Utakuwa na mizeituni kila mahali katika nchi yako, lakini hutakuwa na mafuta ya zeituni ya kujipaka ngozi, kwa sababu zeituni zitaanguka kabla hazijaiva.

decisions.choice: anoint with oil: rub oil on the skin
decisions.reason: In a hot, dry land people rubbed olive oil into skin and hair to soothe and protect them, especially on days of joy (Ruth 3:3; 2 Samuel 14:2).

decisions.choice: drop off: fall before ripening
decisions.reason: The olives will drop from the trees before they can be pressed for oil.

decisions.choice: before they are ripe
decisions.reason: Readable says why the fallen olives give no oil.

source.text: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְלֹא־יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Sons and daughters you will father, and not they will be to you, for they will go into captivity.

en.L: Sons and daughters you will father, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
en.B: You will have sons and daughters, but they will not stay with you, because they will be taken away as captives.
en.R: You will have sons and daughters, but you will lose them, because they will be taken away as prisoners of war.

es.L: Hijos e hijas engendrarás, pero no serán tuyos, porque irán en cautiverio.
es.B: Tendrás hijos e hijas, pero no se quedarán contigo, porque serán llevados cautivos.
es.R: Tendrás hijos e hijas, pero los perderás, porque se los llevarán como prisioneros de guerra.

fr.L: Des fils et des filles tu engendreras, mais ils ne seront pas à toi, car ils iront en captivité.
fr.B: Tu auras des fils et des filles, mais ils ne resteront pas avec toi, car ils seront emmenés en captivité.
fr.R: Tu auras des fils et des filles, mais tu les perdras, car ils seront emmenés comme prisonniers de guerre.

sw.L: Wana na binti utazaa, lakini hawatakuwa wako, kwa maana watakwenda utumwani.
sw.B: Utapata wana na binti, lakini hawatakaa nawe, kwa sababu watachukuliwa mateka.
sw.R: Utapata wana na binti, lakini utawapoteza, kwa sababu watachukuliwa kama wafungwa wa vita.

decisions.choice: captivity: carried off by an enemy
decisions.reason: The word is used for people taken away in war to live as captives in a foreign land (21:10; Numbers 21:1).

decisions.choice: have
decisions.reason: The verb is "beget, father", spoken to the people as a whole. Balanced and Readable say "have", which covers both parents; Literal keeps "father".

source.text: כָּל־עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: All your trees and [the] fruit of your ground will take possession of the whirring locust.

en.L: All your trees and the fruit of your ground the whirring locust will take possession of.
en.B: Swarms of insects will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.
en.R: Swarms of insects will eat up all your trees and your crops.

es.L: Todos tus árboles y el fruto de tu suelo, la langosta zumbadora tomará posesión [de ellos].
es.B: Enjambres de insectos se apoderarán de todos tus árboles y de las cosechas de tu tierra.
es.R: Enjambres de insectos se comerán todos tus árboles y tus cosechas.

fr.L: Tous tes arbres et le fruit de ton sol, la sauterelle stridente en prendra possession.
fr.B: Des essaims d’insectes envahiront tous tes arbres et les récoltes de ton pays.
fr.R: Des essaims d’insectes dévoreront tous tes arbres et tes récoltes.

sw.L: Miti yako yote na tunda la ardhi yako, nzige wavumao wataimiliki.
sw.B: Makundi ya wadudu yatachukua miti yako yote na mazao ya nchi yako.
sw.R: Makundi ya wadudu yatakula miti yako yote na mazao yako.

decisions.choice: the whirring locust: a swarming insect
decisions.reason: The word imitates a buzzing or whirring sound and names an insect, probably a kind of locust or cricket. Which one is not certain.

decisions.choice: take possession of: the word used for Israel taking the land
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used again and again for Israel taking possession of Canaan (verses 21, 63). Now insects will take possession of what Israel grows.

decisions.choice: swarms of insects
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a general phrase, since the exact insect is not known; Literal says "whirring locust". Readable says "eat up" for "take possession of".

source.text: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: The sojourner who [is] in your midst will go up above you upward upward, and you will go down downward downward.

en.L: The sojourner who [is] in your midst will rise above you higher and higher, and you will go down lower and lower.
en.B: The outsider living among you will rise above you higher and higher, while you sink lower and lower.
en.R: The outsiders who live among you will become more and more powerful than you, while you become weaker and weaker.

es.L: El extranjero que [está] en medio de ti subirá sobre ti más y más alto, y tú descenderás más y más bajo.
es.B: El inmigrante que vive en medio de ti se elevará sobre ti cada vez más alto, mientras tú te hundes cada vez más bajo.
es.R: Los extranjeros que viven entre los tuyos serán cada vez más poderosos que tú, mientras tú te vuelves cada vez más débil.

fr.L: L’étranger qui [est] au milieu de toi montera au-dessus de toi de plus en plus haut, et toi, tu descendras de plus en plus bas.
fr.B: L’immigré qui vit chez toi s’élèvera au-dessus de toi toujours plus haut, tandis que toi, tu descendras toujours plus bas.
fr.R: Les étrangers qui vivent chez toi deviendront de plus en plus puissants que toi, alors que toi, tu deviendras de plus en plus faible.

sw.L: Mgeni aliye katikati yako atapanda juu yako juu zaidi na zaidi, nawe utashuka chini zaidi na zaidi.
sw.B: Mgeni anayeishi kati yako atainuka juu yako zaidi na zaidi, nawe utazidi kushuka chini.
sw.R: Wageni wanaoishi kati yako watazidi kuwa na nguvu kuliko wewe, nawe utazidi kuwa dhaifu.

decisions.choice: the sojourner: an outsider living in Israel without land
decisions.reason: The sojourner was usually poor and needed protection (10:18-19; 24:17). In the curse he becomes greater than the Israelite who owns the land.

decisions.choice: upward upward, downward downward: more and more
decisions.reason: Each word is doubled to show steady increase: the outsider keeps rising and Israel keeps sinking.

decisions.choice: outsider (Balanced); outsiders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sojourner"; Balanced says "outsider" and Readable "outsiders who live among you", as elsewhere in Deuteronomy.

source.text: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: He will lend to you, and you not will lend to him; he will become [the] head, and you will become [the] tail.

en.L: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him; he will be the head, and you will be the tail.
en.B: He will lend to you, but you will have nothing to lend to him. He will be the head, and you the tail.
en.R: They will lend money to you, but you will not have enough to lend to them. They will be the leaders, and you will be the followers.

es.L: Él te prestará, y tú no le prestarás; él será la cabeza, y tú serás la cola.
es.B: Él te prestará, pero tú no tendrás nada que prestarle. Él será la cabeza, y tú la cola.
es.R: Ellos te prestarán dinero, pero tú no tendrás suficiente para prestarles. Ellos dirigirán, y tú los seguirás.

fr.L: Lui te prêtera, et toi, tu ne lui prêteras pas ; lui sera la tête, et toi, tu seras la queue.
fr.B: Il te prêtera, mais toi, tu n’auras rien à lui prêter. Il sera la tête, et toi la queue.
fr.R: Ils te prêteront de l’argent, mais toi, tu n’en auras pas assez pour leur en prêter. Ce sont eux qui dirigeront, et toi, tu suivras.

sw.L: Yeye atakukopesha, wala wewe hutamkopesha; yeye atakuwa kichwa, nawe utakuwa mkia.
sw.B: Atakukopesha, lakini wewe hutakuwa na kitu cha kumkopesha. Yeye atakuwa kichwa, nawe mkia.
sw.R: Watakukopesha fedha, lakini wewe hutakuwa na za kutosha kuwakopesha. Wao watakuwa viongozi, nawe utakuwa mfuasi.

decisions.choice: lend and borrow, head and tail: verses 12-13 turned around
decisions.reason: The blessings promised Israel would lend and be the head. Now the outsider of verse 43 holds that place.

decisions.choice: They; the leaders, the followers
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plural for the sojourner of verse 43 and explains "head" and "tail" as in verse 13.

source.text: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֨וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will come on you all the curses these, and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because not you listened to [the] voice of Yahweh your God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

en.L: And all these curses will come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, to keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded you.
en.B: All these curses will come on you. They will hunt you down and catch up with you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God by keeping the commandments and statutes {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded you.
en.R: All these curses will come to you. They will chase you and find you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and keep the commands and laws {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you.

es.L: Y vendrán sobre ti todas estas maldiciones, y te perseguirán y te alcanzarán hasta que seas destruido, porque no escuchaste la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, para guardar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos que te mandó.
es.B: Todas estas maldiciones vendrán sobre ti. Te perseguirán y te darán alcance hasta que seas destruido, porque no obedeciste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios guardando los mandamientos y estatutos que te ordenó.
es.R: Todas estas maldiciones vendrán a ti. Te perseguirán y te encontrarán hasta que seas destruido, porque no obedeciste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios ni cumpliste los mandamientos y leyes que te dio.

fr.L: Et toutes ces malédictions viendront sur toi, et te poursuivront, et t’atteindront jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit, parce que tu n’as pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour garder {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a commandés.
fr.B: Toutes ces malédictions viendront sur toi. Elles te traqueront et te rattraperont jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit, parce que tu n’as pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu en gardant les commandements et les prescriptions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donnés.
fr.R: Toutes ces malédictions viendront à toi. Elles te poursuivront et te trouveront jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit, parce que tu n’as pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu n’as pas gardé les commandements et les lois qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donnés.

sw.L: Na laana hizi zote zitakuja juu yako, na kukufuatia, na kukupata mpaka uangamizwe, kwa sababu hukuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} alizokuamuru.
sw.B: Laana hizi zote zitakujia. Zitakuwinda na kukufikia mpaka uangamizwe, kwa sababu hukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa kuzishika amri na kanuni alizokuamuru.
sw.R: Laana hizi zote zitakujia. Zitakufukuza na kukupata mpaka uangamizwe, kwa sababu hukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuzishika amri na sheria alizokupa.

decisions.choice: because you did not listen: looking back from the time of the curses
decisions.reason: Moses speaks as if the disobedience has already happened, looking back from the time when the curses have come. The verse rounds off the curses of verses 15-44 with the words of verse 15.

decisions.choice: pursue and overtake
decisions.reason: The curses chase Israel and catch it, as in verses 2, 15 and 22.

decisions.choice: commandments and statutes (Balanced); commands and laws (Readable)
decisions.reason: These are the settled words for this pair in Deuteronomy, as in verse 15.

source.text: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be on you as a sign and as a wonder, and on your offspring, forever.

en.L: And they will be on you as a sign and as a wonder, and on your offspring, forever.
en.B: They will be a sign and a warning against you and your descendants forever.
en.R: These curses will be a sign and a warning to you and your descendants for all time.

es.L: Y estarán sobre ti como señal y como prodigio, y sobre tu descendencia, para siempre.
es.B: Serán una señal y una advertencia contra ti y contra tu descendencia para siempre.
es.R: Estas maldiciones serán una señal y una advertencia para ti y para tus descendientes por todos los tiempos.

fr.L: Et elles seront sur toi comme un signe et comme un prodige, et sur ta descendance, pour toujours.
fr.B: Elles seront un signe et un avertissement contre toi et contre ta descendance, pour toujours.
fr.R: Ces malédictions seront un signe et un avertissement pour toi et pour tes descendants, à tout jamais.

sw.L: Nazo zitakuwa juu yako kuwa ishara na ajabu, na juu ya uzao wako, milele.
sw.B: Zitakuwa ishara na onyo dhidi yako na uzao wako milele.
sw.R: Laana hizi zitakuwa ishara na onyo kwako na kwa wazao wako daima.

decisions.choice: a sign and a wonder: events that show the LORD at work
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in Deuteronomy "signs and wonders" are the plagues the LORD sent on Egypt (4:34; 6:22; 7:19). Now Israel itself will become such a sign, showing his judgment to everyone who sees it.

decisions.choice: forever: for generations to come
decisions.reason: The phrase means for a very long time, passing from parents to their descendants.

decisions.choice: a warning
decisions.reason: Here the wonder is a fearful one that teaches a lesson. Balanced and Readable say "warning" so the reader does not hear "wonder" as something good; Literal keeps "wonder".

source.text: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־עָבַ֨דְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Because that not you served Yahweh your God with joy and with goodness of heart from [the] abundance of everything,

en.L: Because you did not serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with joy and with gladness of heart, from the abundance of everything,
en.B: Since you did not serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God joyfully and with a glad heart when you had plenty of everything,
en.R: You had plenty of everything, but you did not serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with joy and a glad heart.

es.L: Porque no serviste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios con alegría y con corazón contento, desde la abundancia de todo,
es.B: Ya que no serviste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios con alegría y de buen corazón cuando tenías abundancia de todo,
es.R: Tenías de todo en abundancia, pero no serviste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios con alegría y con un corazón contento.

fr.L: Parce que tu n’as pas servi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu avec joie et avec un cœur heureux, dans l’abondance de toutes choses,
fr.B: Puisque tu n’as pas servi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu avec joie et de bon cœur quand tu avais de tout en abondance,
fr.R: Tu avais de tout en abondance, mais tu n’as pas servi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu avec joie et de bon cœur.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hukumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa furaha na kwa moyo mchangamfu, katika wingi wa vitu vyote,
sw.B: Kwa kuwa hukumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa shangwe na moyo mkunjufu ulipokuwa na wingi wa kila kitu,
sw.R: Ulikuwa na kila kitu kwa wingi, lakini hukumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa furaha na kwa moyo mkunjufu.

decisions.choice: from the abundance of everything: when you had plenty
alternatives: more than for all your plenty
decisions.reason: The words most likely mean "in the time when you had plenty of everything". They may also mean "because of all your plenty", or that Israel should have served with more joy than all its wealth brought it.

decisions.choice: serve with joy and a glad heart
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy calls Israel to rejoice before the LORD for all he has given (12:7, 12; 16:11; 26:11). Failing to serve him gladly in good times is the reason given for the slavery of verse 48.

decisions.choice: You had plenty of everything, but
decisions.reason: Readable puts the time of plenty first and closes the sentence; verse 48 then begins "So".

source.text: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל־צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: and you will serve your enemies whom will send him Yahweh against you, in hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of everything; and he will put a yoke of iron on your neck until he has destroyed you.

en.L: and you will serve your enemies whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send against you, in hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of everything; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will put a yoke of iron on your neck until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has destroyed you.
en.B: you will serve the enemies {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends against you, in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and in need of everything. He will lay an iron yoke on your neck until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has destroyed you.
en.R: So you will serve your enemies, whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send against you. You will be hungry, thirsty, without clothes and in need of everything. He will put a heavy iron yoke on your neck, as on an ox, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has destroyed you.

es.L: servirás a tus enemigos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará contra ti, con hambre y con sed y con desnudez y con falta de todo; y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pondrá un yugo de hierro sobre tu cuello hasta que te haya destruido.
es.B: servirás a los enemigos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envíe contra ti, con hambre y sed, desnudo y falto de todo. Él pondrá un yugo de hierro sobre tu cuello hasta destruirte.
es.R: Por eso servirás a tus enemigos, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará contra ti. Tendrás hambre y sed, no tendrás ropa y te faltará de todo. Él pondrá sobre tu cuello un pesado yugo de hierro, como a un buey, hasta destruirte.

fr.L: tu serviras tes ennemis que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra contre toi, dans la faim, et dans la soif, et dans la nudité, et dans le manque de toutes choses ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mettra un joug de fer sur ton cou jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait détruit.
fr.B: tu serviras les ennemis que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra contre toi, dans la faim et la soif, dans la nudité et le dénuement complet. Il mettra un joug de fer sur ton cou jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait détruit.
fr.R: Alors tu serviras tes ennemis, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra contre toi. Tu auras faim et soif, tu n’auras pas de vêtements, et tu manqueras de tout. Il mettra sur ton cou un lourd joug de fer, comme sur un bœuf, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’ait détruit.

sw.L: nawe utawatumikia adui zako ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatuma dhidi yako, katika njaa, na katika kiu, na katika uchi, na katika kupungukiwa na kila kitu; {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ataweka nira ya chuma shingoni mwako mpaka atakapokuangamiza.
sw.B: utawatumikia adui ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatuma dhidi yako, ukiwa na njaa na kiu, ukiwa uchi na ukihitaji kila kitu. Ataweka nira ya chuma shingoni mwako mpaka atakapokuangamiza.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo utawatumikia adui zako, ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatuma dhidi yako. Utakuwa na njaa na kiu, bila nguo, na ukihitaji kila kitu. Ataweka nira nzito ya chuma shingoni mwako, kama kwa ng'ombe, mpaka atakapokuangamiza.

decisions.choice: he will put a yoke ... until he has destroyed you: the LORD
alternatives: the enemy puts the yoke on your neck
decisions.reason: The nearest subject is the LORD, and in Jeremiah 28:14 the LORD says, "I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations." But the enemy has just been spoken of as "him", so the enemy could be the one who puts on the yoke. This translation takes the LORD as the subject.

decisions.choice: a yoke of iron: harsh, unbreakable servitude
decisions.reason: The yoke was the wooden bar laid on the neck of oxen for work. An iron yoke is one that cannot be broken off (Jeremiah 28:13-14; 1 Kings 12:4).

decisions.choice: you will serve: the same word as in verse 47
decisions.reason: Those who would not serve the LORD gladly in plenty will serve their enemies in want.

decisions.choice: heavy; as on an ox
decisions.reason: Readable explains the yoke picture.

source.text: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵרָחוֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will raise Yahweh against you a nation from afar, from [the] end of the earth, as swoops the eagle, a nation whose language not you will understand,

en.L: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will raise against you a nation from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle swoops down, a nation whose language you will not understand,
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring against you a nation from far away, from the end of the earth, swooping down like an eagle, a nation whose language you will not understand,
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring a nation from far away to attack you. It will come from the end of the earth and swoop down on you like an eagle. You will not understand its language.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} levantará contra ti una nación de lejos, del extremo de la tierra, como se lanza el águila, una nación cuya lengua no entenderás,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} traerá contra ti una nación lejana, del extremo de la tierra, que se lanzará como un águila, una nación cuya lengua no entenderás,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} traerá de lejos una nación para atacarte. Vendrá del fin del mundo y caerá sobre ti como un águila. No entenderás su idioma.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera lever contre toi une nation de loin, de l’extrémité de la terre, comme fond l’aigle, une nation dont tu ne comprendras pas la langue,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera venir contre toi une nation lointaine, du bout de la terre, qui fondra comme l’aigle, une nation dont tu ne comprendras pas la langue,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera venir de loin une nation pour t’attaquer. Elle viendra du bout de la terre et fondra sur toi comme un aigle. Tu ne comprendras pas sa langue.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atainua dhidi yako taifa kutoka mbali, kutoka mwisho wa dunia, kama tai ashukavyo kwa kasi, taifa ambalo lugha yake hutaielewa,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataleta dhidi yako taifa kutoka mbali, kutoka mwisho wa dunia, likishuka kama tai, taifa ambalo hutaielewa lugha yake,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataleta taifa kutoka mbali kukushambulia. Litakuja kutoka mwisho wa dunia na kukurukia kama tai. Hutaielewa lugha yake.

decisions.choice: eagle: a great bird of prey
decisions.reason: The word can name the eagle or the griffon vulture. The picture is of a sudden, swift attack from far off (Jeremiah 48:40; Habakkuk 1:8).

decisions.choice: from the end of the earth: from very far away
decisions.reason: The phrase points to a distant land beyond Israel's knowledge, as in verse 64.

decisions.choice: a language you will not understand: a wholly foreign enemy
decisions.reason: With no common language there can be no pleading or bargaining (Isaiah 28:11; Jeremiah 5:15).

decisions.choice: three sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long description, which in the Hebrew runs on to verse 51, into short sentences.

source.text: גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: a nation fierce of face, which not will lift face to [the] old, and [the] young not will show favor,

en.L: a nation fierce of face, which will not lift up [the] face to the old, and to the young will not show favor,
en.B: a hard-faced nation that will show no respect to the old and no pity to the young,
en.R: Its people will be fierce and cruel. They will show no respect for old people and no pity for children.

es.L: una nación de rostro feroz, que no alzará [el] rostro al anciano, y al joven no mostrará favor,
es.B: una nación de rostro duro, que no tendrá respeto por el anciano ni compasión del joven,
es.R: Su gente será feroz y cruel. No tendrán respeto por los ancianos ni compasión de los niños.

fr.L: une nation au visage dur, qui ne relèvera pas [le] visage vers le vieillard, et au jeune ne fera pas grâce,
fr.B: une nation au visage dur, qui n’aura aucun égard pour les vieillards ni aucune pitié pour les jeunes,
fr.R: Ses gens seront durs et cruels. Ils n’auront aucun respect pour les personnes âgées et aucune pitié pour les enfants.

sw.L: taifa lenye uso mkali, ambalo halitainua uso kwa mzee, wala halitamhurumia kijana,
sw.B: taifa lenye uso mgumu, lisilomheshimu mzee wala kumhurumia kijana,
sw.R: Watu wake watakuwa wakali na wakatili. Hawatawaheshimu wazee wala kuwahurumia watoto.

decisions.choice: fierce of face: hard and merciless
decisions.reason: A hard face is one that shows no softness or shame (Daniel 8:23; Proverbs 7:13).

decisions.choice: lift up the face to the old: show them regard
decisions.reason: To lift someone's face is to treat them with favor and respect. Old age was to be honored (Leviticus 19:32), but this nation will spare neither old nor young.

decisions.choice: show no respect, no pity
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idioms mean; Literal keeps "lift up the face" and "show favor".

source.text: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: and it will eat [the] fruit of your livestock and [the] fruit of your ground until you are destroyed, which not will leave to you grain, new wine and fresh oil, [the] young of your cattle and [the] young of your flock, until it has made you perish.

en.L: and it will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground until you are destroyed; it will not leave you grain, new wine or oil, the offspring of your cattle or the young of your flock, until it has made you perish.
en.B: and it will eat the young of your livestock and the harvest of your soil until you are destroyed. It will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, none of the young of your cattle or your sheep, until it has ruined you.
en.R: They will eat your young animals and your crops until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, no calves or lambs. In the end you will be ruined.

es.L: y comerá el fruto de tu ganado y el fruto de tu suelo hasta que seas destruido; no te dejará grano, mosto ni aceite, ni la cría de tus vacas ni las crías de tus ovejas, hasta que te haya hecho perecer.
es.B: y se comerá las crías de tu ganado y la cosecha de tu suelo hasta que seas destruido. No te dejará grano, vino nuevo ni aceite de oliva, ni ninguna cría de tus vacas o de tus ovejas, hasta arruinarte.
es.R: Se comerán tus animales jóvenes y tus cosechas hasta que seas destruido. No te dejarán grano, vino nuevo ni aceite de oliva, ni terneros ni corderos. Al final quedarás arruinado.

fr.L: et elle mangera le fruit de ton bétail et le fruit de ton sol jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit ; elle ne te laissera ni grain, ni vin nouveau, ni huile, ni la portée de tes vaches, ni les petits de ton petit bétail, jusqu’à ce qu’elle t’ait fait périr.
fr.B: et elle mangera les petits de ton bétail et la récolte de ton sol jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit. Elle ne te laissera ni grain, ni vin nouveau, ni huile d’olive, aucun des petits de tes vaches ou de tes brebis, jusqu’à ce qu’elle t’ait ruiné.
fr.R: Ils mangeront tes jeunes animaux et tes récoltes jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit. Ils ne te laisseront ni grain, ni vin nouveau, ni huile d’olive, ni veaux, ni agneaux. À la fin, tu seras ruiné.

sw.L: nalo litakula tunda la mifugo yako na tunda la ardhi yako mpaka uangamizwe; halitakuachia nafaka, divai mpya wala mafuta, uzao wa ng'ombe wako wala wadogo wa kundi lako la kondoo, mpaka litakapokuangamiza.
sw.B: nalo litakula wadogo wa mifugo yako na mavuno ya ardhi yako mpaka uangamizwe. Halitakuachia nafaka, divai mpya wala mafuta ya zeituni, wala ndama wa ng'ombe wako wala wana-kondoo wa kondoo wako, mpaka litakapokuharibu kabisa.
sw.R: Watakula wanyama wako wachanga na mazao yako mpaka uangamizwe. Hawatakuachia nafaka, divai mpya wala mafuta ya zeituni, wala ndama wala wana-kondoo. Mwishowe utaharibiwa kabisa.

decisions.choice: grain, new wine and oil, young of cattle and flock: the blessings of 7:13 taken away
decisions.reason: The list is the one the LORD promised to bless in 7:13 and in verse 4. Now a foreign nation will eat it all.

decisions.choice: young of your livestock, harvest of your soil; calves, lambs
decisions.reason: The wording follows verse 4 at each level.

decisions.choice: They
decisions.reason: Readable speaks of the nation as "they", as in verse 50.

source.text: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹה֣וֹת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל־אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will besiege you in all your gates until come down your walls the high and the fortified in which you [are] trusting, in all your land; and it will besiege you in all your gates in all your land which has given Yahweh your God to you.

en.L: And it will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls come down, in which you are trusting, in all your land; and it will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given to you.
en.B: It will besiege all your towns until the high, fortified walls you trust in come down throughout your land. It will besiege all your towns throughout the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given you.
en.R: They will surround all your towns and attack them, until the high, strong walls you trust in fall down all over your land. They will attack every town in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given you.

es.L: Y te sitiará en todas tus puertas hasta que caigan tus muros altos y fortificados en los que confías, en toda tu tierra; y te sitiará en todas tus puertas en toda tu tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dado.
es.B: Sitiará todas tus ciudades hasta que caigan en toda tu tierra los muros altos y fortificados en los que confías. Sitiará todas tus ciudades en toda la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dado.
es.R: Rodearán todas tus ciudades y las atacarán, hasta que los muros altos y fuertes en los que confías se derrumben por toda tu tierra. Atacarán cada ciudad de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dado.

fr.L: Et elle t’assiégera dans toutes tes portes jusqu’à ce que tombent tes murailles hautes et fortifiées, sur lesquelles tu comptes, dans tout ton pays ; et elle t’assiégera dans toutes tes portes, dans tout ton pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donné.
fr.B: Elle assiégera toutes tes villes jusqu’à ce que tombent, dans tout ton pays, les hautes murailles fortifiées sur lesquelles tu comptes. Elle assiégera toutes tes villes dans tout le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donné.
fr.R: Ils encercleront toutes tes villes et les attaqueront, jusqu’à ce que les murailles hautes et solides sur lesquelles tu comptes s’écroulent partout dans ton pays. Ils attaqueront chaque ville du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donné.

sw.L: Nalo litakuzingira katika malango yako yote mpaka kuta zako ndefu na zenye ngome, unazozitumainia, zianguke katika nchi yako yote; nalo litakuzingira katika malango yako yote katika nchi yako yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa.
sw.B: Litaizingira miji yako yote mpaka kuta ndefu zenye ngome unazozitegemea zianguke katika nchi yako yote. Litaizingira miji yako yote katika nchi yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa.
sw.R: Wataizunguka na kuishambulia miji yako yote, mpaka kuta ndefu na imara unazozitegemea zianguke kila mahali katika nchi yako. Watashambulia kila mji katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa.

decisions.choice: your gates: your towns
decisions.reason: The gate stands for the whole walled town, as often in Deuteronomy (12:15; 16:5).

decisions.choice: the walls you trust in
decisions.reason: Israel's high walls will not save it; its safety was in the LORD (1:28-30; 9:1-3).

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "towns" for "gates"; Literal keeps "gates".

source.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר־יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will eat [the] fruit of your womb, [the] flesh of your sons and your daughters whom has given to you Yahweh your God, in [the] siege and in [the] distress with which will distress you your enemy.

en.L: And you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your sons and your daughters whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given to you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you.
en.B: Then in the siege and in the distress your enemy brings upon you, you will eat your own children, the flesh of the sons and daughters {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given you.
en.R: When your enemy has you under siege and you are desperate, you will eat your own children, the sons and daughters {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God gave you.

es.L: Y comerás el fruto de tu vientre, la carne de tus hijos y de tus hijas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dado, en el asedio y en la angustia con que te angustiará tu enemigo.
es.B: Entonces, en el asedio y en la angustia a que te someterá tu enemigo, comerás a tus propios hijos, la carne de los hijos y de las hijas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dado.
es.R: Cuando tu enemigo te tenga sitiado y estés desesperado, comerás a tus propios hijos, los hijos y las hijas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te dio.

fr.L: Et tu mangeras le fruit de ton sein, la chair de tes fils et de tes filles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donnés, dans le siège et dans la détresse dont ton ennemi te pressera.
fr.B: Alors, pendant le siège et dans la détresse où ton ennemi te réduira, tu mangeras tes propres enfants, la chair des fils et des filles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donnés.
fr.R: Quand ton ennemi t’assiégera et que tu seras désespéré, tu mangeras tes propres enfants, les fils et les filles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donnés.

sw.L: Nawe utakula tunda la tumbo lako, nyama ya wana wako na binti zako ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa, katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki ambayo adui yako atakudhikisha nayo.
sw.B: Ndipo katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki atakayokuletea adui yako, utakula watoto wako mwenyewe, nyama ya wana na binti ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa.
sw.R: Adui yako atakapokuzingira, ukiwa huna tumaini lolote, utakula watoto wako mwenyewe, wana na binti ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikupa.

decisions.choice: eating your own children: the horror of a long siege
decisions.reason: When a city was shut in until its food ran out, people starved, and this did happen (2 Kings 6:26-29; Lamentations 2:20; 4:10). Leviticus 26:29 gives the same warning.

decisions.choice: the fruit of your womb: your own children
decisions.reason: The children promised as a blessing in verse 4 become the food of their parents.

decisions.choice: the siege and the distress with which your enemy will distress you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words for "siege" and "distress" sound alike, and "distress" is repeated as a verb. The phrase comes back in verses 55 and 57.

decisions.choice: the siege clause first
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the siege first, so the reader knows the setting before the horror that follows. The siege line is worded the same way in verses 55 and 57.

source.text: הָאִישׁ֙ הָרַ֣ךְ בְּךָ֔ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤וֹ בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔וֹ וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: The man the tender among you and the delicate very, will be evil his eye toward his brother and toward [the] wife of his bosom and toward [the] rest of his children whom he has left,

en.L: The man who is tender among you and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother and toward the wife of his bosom and toward the rest of his children whom he has left,
en.B: Even the most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge food to his own brother, to the wife he holds close and to the children he still has left,
en.R: Even the kindest and gentlest man among you will turn cruel and selfish toward his own brother, the wife he loves and the children he still has.

es.L: El hombre tierno en medio de ti y muy delicado, su ojo será malo para con su hermano, y para con la mujer de su seno, y para con el resto de sus hijos que le queden,
es.B: Aun el hombre más gentil y refinado de tu pueblo le negará la comida a su propio hermano, a la mujer que abraza y a los hijos que aún le queden,
es.R: Aun el hombre más bondadoso y amable de tu pueblo se volverá cruel y egoísta con su propio hermano, con la esposa que ama y con los hijos que todavía tenga.

fr.L: L’homme tendre au milieu de toi et très délicat, son œil sera mauvais envers son frère, et envers la femme de son sein, et envers le reste de ses enfants qu’il a laissés,
fr.B: Même l’homme le plus doux et le plus raffiné de ton peuple refusera de partager avec son propre frère, avec la femme qu’il serre contre lui et avec les enfants qui lui restent,
fr.R: Même l’homme le plus gentil et le plus doux de ton peuple deviendra dur et égoïste envers son propre frère, la femme qu’il aime et les enfants qui lui restent.

sw.L: Mwanamume aliye mwororo kati yako na mwenye adabu nyingi, jicho lake litakuwa ovu kwa ndugu yake, na kwa mke wa kifuani mwake, na kwa watoto wake waliosalia aliowabakiza,
sw.B: Hata mwanamume mpole na mstaarabu kuliko wote kati yako atamnyima chakula ndugu yake mwenyewe, mke anayemkumbatia, na watoto aliobaki nao,
sw.R: Hata mwanamume mwema na mpole kuliko wote kati yako atakuwa mkatili na mchoyo kwa ndugu yake mwenyewe, kwa mke anayempenda na kwa watoto aliobaki nao.

decisions.choice: his eye will be evil: he will begrudge, be mean
decisions.reason: An "evil eye" in Hebrew is a grudging, stingy look, the opposite of generosity (15:9; Proverbs 23:6; 28:22). The man will refuse to share.

decisions.choice: the wife of his bosom: his dearly loved wife
decisions.reason: The wife who lies in his embrace (13:7; Micah 7:5).

decisions.choice: tender and very delicate: used to comfort and refinement
decisions.reason: The words describe a man raised softly, gentle and sensitive. Even such a man will be made heartless by hunger.

decisions.choice: begrudge food (Balanced); turn cruel and selfish (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means; Literal keeps "his eye will be evil". Verse 56 uses the same wording for the woman.

source.text: מִתֵּ֣ת׀לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ל֖וֹ כֹּ֑ל בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: from giving to one of them of [the] flesh of his children whom he eats, because not left to him anything, in [the] siege and in [the] distress with which will distress you your enemy in all your gates.

en.L: so as not to give to any one of them some of the flesh of his children whom he eats, because nothing has been left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
en.B: and will not give any of them the flesh of his children that he is eating, because he has nothing else left, in the siege and in the distress your enemy brings upon you in all your towns.
en.R: He will not give any of them the flesh of his children that he is eating, because he will have nothing else left when your enemy has you under siege in all your towns and you are desperate.

es.L: para no dar a ninguno de ellos de la carne de sus hijos que come, porque nada le ha quedado, en el asedio y en la angustia con que te angustiará tu enemigo en todas tus puertas.
es.B: y no dará a ninguno de ellos de la carne de sus hijos que está comiendo, porque no le queda nada más, en el asedio y en la angustia a que te someterá tu enemigo en todas tus ciudades.
es.R: No dará a ninguno de ellos de la carne de sus hijos que está comiendo, porque no le quedará nada más, cuando tu enemigo te tenga sitiado en todas tus ciudades y estés desesperado.

fr.L: de sorte qu’il ne donnera à aucun d’eux de la chair de ses enfants qu’il mange, parce qu’il ne lui est rien resté, dans le siège et dans la détresse dont ton ennemi te pressera dans toutes tes portes.
fr.B: et il ne donnera à aucun d’eux de la chair de ses enfants qu’il mange, parce qu’il ne lui reste rien d’autre, pendant le siège et dans la détresse où ton ennemi te réduira dans toutes tes villes.
fr.R: Il ne donnera à aucun d’eux de la chair de ses enfants qu’il mange, parce qu’il n’aura plus rien d’autre, quand ton ennemi t’assiégera dans toutes tes villes et que tu seras désespéré.

sw.L: hata asimpe yeyote kati yao nyama ya watoto wake anaowala, kwa sababu hakuachiwa kitu, katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki ambayo adui yako atakudhikisha nayo katika malango yako yote.
sw.B: wala hatampa yeyote kati yao nyama ya watoto wake anaowala, kwa sababu hana kitu kingine kilichobaki, katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki atakayokuletea adui yako katika miji yako yote.
sw.R: Hatampa yeyote kati yao nyama ya watoto wake anaowala, kwa sababu hatakuwa na kitu kingine, adui yako atakapokuzingira katika miji yako yote, ukiwa huna tumaini lolote.

decisions.choice: from giving: so that he will not give
decisions.reason: The begrudging of verse 54 is explained: he will not share any of the flesh of the children he is eating with the family who are still alive.

decisions.choice: because nothing has been left to him
decisions.reason: He has nothing else to eat, so he keeps even this to himself.

decisions.choice: the siege line as in verse 53; towns
decisions.reason: The siege line is worded as in verse 53, with "in all your gates" (Balanced and Readable "towns", as in verse 52).

source.text: הָרַכָּ֨ה בְךָ֜ וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף־רַגְלָהּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: The tender and the delicate [woman] among you, who not has tried [the] sole of her foot to set on the ground from delicacy and from tenderness, will be evil her eye toward [the] husband of her bosom and toward her son and toward her daughter,

en.L: The tender and delicate [woman] among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of delicacy and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband of her bosom and toward her son and toward her daughter,
en.B: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so delicate and pampered that she would never venture to put the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge food to the husband she holds close, to her son and to her daughter,
en.R: Even the gentlest woman among you, who has lived in such comfort that she would not even set her foot on the ground, will turn cruel and selfish toward the husband she loves and toward her son and daughter.

es.L: La [mujer] tierna y delicada en medio de ti, que no se habría aventurado a poner la planta de su pie en el suelo por delicadeza y por ternura, su ojo será malo para con el marido de su seno, y para con su hijo, y para con su hija,
es.B: La mujer más gentil y refinada de tu pueblo, tan delicada y mimada que nunca se habría atrevido a poner la planta del pie en el suelo, le negará la comida al marido que abraza, a su hijo y a su hija,
es.R: Aun la mujer más gentil de tu pueblo, que ha vivido con tanta comodidad que ni siquiera ponía el pie en el suelo, se volverá cruel y egoísta con el marido que ama y con su hijo y su hija.

fr.L: La [femme] tendre et délicate au milieu de toi, qui ne se serait pas risquée à poser la plante de son pied sur le sol par délicatesse et par tendresse, son œil sera mauvais envers le mari de son sein, et envers son fils, et envers sa fille,
