fr.B: La femme la plus douce et la plus raffinée de ton peuple, si délicate et si choyée qu’elle n’aurait jamais osé poser la plante de son pied par terre, refusera de partager avec le mari qu’elle serre contre elle, avec son fils et avec sa fille,
fr.R: Même la femme la plus douce de ton peuple, qui a vécu dans un tel confort qu’elle ne posait même pas le pied par terre, deviendra dure et égoïste envers le mari qu’elle aime, envers son fils et sa fille.

sw.L: [Mwanamke] mwororo na mwenye adabu kati yako, ambaye hangejaribu kuuweka wayo wa mguu wake juu ya ardhi kwa sababu ya adabu na wororo, jicho lake litakuwa ovu kwa mume wa kifuani mwake, na kwa mwanawe, na kwa binti yake,
sw.B: Mwanamke mpole na mstaarabu kuliko wote kati yako, aliyedekezwa sana hata hangethubutu kukanyaga ardhi kwa wayo wa mguu wake, atamnyima chakula mume anayemkumbatia, mwanawe na binti yake,
sw.R: Hata mwanamke mpole kuliko wote kati yako, aliyeishi kwa starehe kiasi kwamba hata hakuweka mguu wake chini, atakuwa mkatili na mchoyo kwa mume anayempenda na kwa mwanawe na binti yake.

decisions.choice: would not set the sole of her foot on the ground: so pampered she never walked
decisions.reason: She was so used to comfort that she would not step on the bare ground, being carried or riding wherever she went. The picture shows how far the siege will bring her down.

decisions.choice: her eye will be evil: as in verse 54
decisions.reason: She will begrudge food to her own family, as the man does in verse 54.

decisions.choice: [woman], woman
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adjectives are feminine and need no noun; English supplies "woman" (bracketed at Literal). The rest follows the wording of verse 54.

source.text: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיּוֹצֵ֣ת׀מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֨יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹֽסֶר־כֹּ֖ל בַּסָּ֑תֶר בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: and toward her afterbirth which comes out from between her feet and toward her children whom she will bear; for she will eat them in lack of everything in secret, in [the] siege and in [the] distress with which will distress you your enemy in your gates.

en.L: and toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her feet and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of everything, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
en.B: and to the afterbirth that comes out from between her legs and to the children she bears. For she will eat them in secret, having nothing else at all, in the siege and in the distress your enemy brings upon you in your towns.
en.R: She will not share even the afterbirth or the baby she gives birth to. She will eat them secretly, because she will have nothing else to eat when your enemy has you under siege in your towns and you are desperate.

es.L: y para con su placenta que sale de entre sus pies, y para con sus hijos que dé a luz; porque se los comerá a escondidas por la falta de todo, en el asedio y en la angustia con que te angustiará tu enemigo en tus puertas.
es.B: y a la placenta que sale de entre sus piernas y a los hijos que dé a luz. Porque se los comerá en secreto, al no tener absolutamente nada, en el asedio y en la angustia a que te someterá tu enemigo en tus ciudades.
es.R: No compartirá ni siquiera la placenta ni el bebé que dé a luz. Se los comerá a escondidas, porque no tendrá nada más que comer cuando tu enemigo te tenga sitiado en tus ciudades y estés desesperado.

fr.L: et envers son placenta qui sort d’entre ses pieds, et envers ses enfants qu’elle enfantera ; car elle les mangera en secret, dans le manque de toutes choses, dans le siège et dans la détresse dont ton ennemi te pressera dans tes portes.
fr.B: avec le placenta qui sort d’entre ses jambes et avec les enfants qu’elle mettra au monde. Car elle les mangera en cachette, n’ayant plus rien du tout, pendant le siège et dans la détresse où ton ennemi te réduira dans tes villes.
fr.R: Elle ne partagera même pas le placenta ni le bébé qu’elle mettra au monde. Elle les mangera en cachette, parce qu’elle n’aura plus rien d’autre à manger, quand ton ennemi t’assiégera dans tes villes et que tu seras désespéré.

sw.L: na kwa kondo lake la nyuma litokalo katikati ya miguu yake, na kwa watoto wake atakaowazaa; kwa maana atawala kwa siri kwa kukosa kila kitu, katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki ambayo adui yako atakudhikisha nayo katika malango yako.
sw.B: na kondo la nyuma litokalo katikati ya miguu yake, na watoto atakaowazaa. Kwa maana atawala kwa siri, kwa kuwa hana kitu kingine kabisa, katika kuzingirwa na katika dhiki atakayokuletea adui yako katika miji yako.
sw.R: Hatashiriki na wengine hata kondo la nyuma wala mtoto atakayemzaa. Atawala kwa siri, kwa sababu hatakuwa na kitu kingine cha kula, adui yako atakapokuzingira katika miji yako, ukiwa huna tumaini lolote.

decisions.choice: afterbirth: what comes out after the baby
decisions.reason: The word means the placenta and membranes that come out after birth. "From between her feet" is a modest way of speaking about childbirth.

decisions.choice: she will eat them in secret
decisions.reason: She hides the newborn and the afterbirth so as not to share them. 2 Kings 6:28-29 and Lamentations 4:10 tell of mothers driven to this in a siege.

decisions.choice: her legs
decisions.reason: Balanced says "legs" for "feet", since in English "between her feet" does not suggest childbirth. Literal keeps "feet".

source.text: אִם־לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־הַשֵּׁ֞ם הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If not you take care to do all [the] words of the law this which [are] written in the book this, to fear the name the glorious and the awesome this, Yahweh your God,

en.L: If you do not take care to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, to fear this glorious and awesome name, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God,
en.B: If you do not carefully keep every word of this law written in this book, and do not fear this glorious and awesome name, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God,
en.R: Be careful to obey every word of the teaching written in this book. Fear the glorious and awesome name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Si no cuidas de poner por obra todas las palabras de esta ley que están escritas en este libro, temiendo este nombre glorioso y temible, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios,
es.B: Si no guardas con cuidado cada palabra de esta ley escrita en este libro, y no temes este nombre glorioso y temible, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios,
es.R: Procura obedecer cada palabra de la enseñanza escrita en este libro. Teme el nombre glorioso y temible {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.

fr.L: Si tu ne veilles pas à pratiquer toutes les paroles de cette loi qui sont écrites dans ce livre, en craignant ce nom glorieux et redoutable, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu,
fr.B: Si tu ne gardes pas avec soin chaque parole de cette loi écrite dans ce livre, et si tu ne crains pas ce nom glorieux et redoutable, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu,
fr.R: Applique-toi à obéir à chaque parole de l’enseignement écrit dans ce livre. Crains le nom glorieux et redoutable {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.

sw.L: Usipojali kuyatenda maneno yote ya sheria hii yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki, kulicha jina hili tukufu na la kutisha, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako,
sw.B: Usipolishika kwa uangalifu kila neno la sheria hii lililoandikwa katika kitabu hiki, wala kulicha jina hili tukufu na la kutisha, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako,
sw.R: Uwe mwangalifu kutii kila neno la mafundisho yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki. Uliche jina tukufu na la kutisha la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.

decisions.choice: this law: the whole of Moses' teaching
decisions.reason: The word means instruction or teaching, the whole of what Moses sets before Israel, not only its rules (1:5; 4:44).

decisions.choice: written in this book: Moses' teaching set down in writing
decisions.reason: This is the first time in the chapter that the teaching is spoken of as a written book. Moses later writes it down and gives it to the priests (17:18; 31:9, 24-26).

decisions.choice: this glorious and awesome name, the LORD your God
decisions.reason: The name stands for the LORD himself as he has made himself known. "The LORD your God" stands after it and says whose name it is.

decisions.choice: teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for this word, as elsewhere in Deuteronomy; Literal and Balanced say "law".

decisions.choice: two commands; the condition in verse 59
decisions.reason: Readable states what Israel must do as commands and gives "If you do not" at the start of verse 59. Literal and Balanced keep the condition open into verse 59.

source.text: וְהִפְלָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶת־מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת מַכּ֣וֹת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלוֹת֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת וָחֳלָיִ֥ם רָעִ֖ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and will make extraordinary Yahweh your plagues and [the] plagues of your offspring, plagues great and lasting, and sicknesses severe and lasting.

en.L: then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make your plagues extraordinary, and the plagues of your offspring, great and lasting plagues, and severe and lasting sicknesses.
en.B: then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike you and your descendants with astonishing plagues, great and lasting plagues and severe and lasting sicknesses.
en.R: If you do not, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send terrible plagues on you and your descendants. They will be great disasters that do not end and severe sicknesses that do not go away.

es.L: entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará extraordinarias tus plagas y las plagas de tu descendencia, plagas grandes y persistentes, y enfermedades graves y persistentes.
es.B: entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te herirá a ti y a tus descendientes con plagas asombrosas, plagas grandes y persistentes y enfermedades graves y persistentes.
es.R: Si no lo haces, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará plagas terribles sobre ti y sobre tus descendientes. Serán grandes desastres que no terminarán y enfermedades graves que no se irán.

fr.L: alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendra extraordinaires tes fléaux et les fléaux de ta descendance, des fléaux grands et durables, et des maladies graves et durables.
fr.B: alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te frappera, toi et tes descendants, de fléaux stupéfiants, de grands fléaux qui dureront et de graves maladies qui ne cesseront pas.
fr.R: Si tu ne le fais pas, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra sur toi et sur tes descendants des fléaux terribles. Ce seront de grands malheurs sans fin et de graves maladies qui ne partiront pas.

sw.L: basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayafanya mapigo yako kuwa ya ajabu, na mapigo ya uzao wako, mapigo makuu na ya kudumu, na magonjwa mabaya na ya kudumu.
sw.B: basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupiga wewe na wazao wako kwa mapigo ya kushangaza, mapigo makuu yasiyokoma na magonjwa makali yasiyokoma.
sw.R: Usipofanya hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea wewe na wazao wako mapigo ya kutisha. Yatakuwa maafa makubwa yasiyokwisha na magonjwa makali yasiyoondoka.

decisions.choice: make extraordinary: beyond anything ordinary
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same root as the "wonders" the LORD did in Egypt. Here the plagues on Israel will be wonders of judgment, beyond what is normal.

decisions.choice: lasting: long and unrelenting
decisions.reason: The word means firm or faithful; said of plagues and sicknesses, it means they will hold on and not let go.

decisions.choice: then
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "and" brings the result of the condition in verse 58, so Literal and Balanced say "then".

source.text: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will bring back on you all [the] diseases of Egypt which you were afraid of them, and they will cling to you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bring back on you every disease of Egypt that you were afraid of, and they will cling to you.
en.B: He will bring back on you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.
en.R: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt that frightened you, and they will not leave you.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} traerá de nuevo sobre ti todas las enfermedades de Egipto que temías, y se te pegarán.
es.B: Traerá de nuevo sobre ti todas las enfermedades de Egipto que tanto temías, y se te pegarán.
es.R: Volverá a traer sobre ti todas las enfermedades de Egipto que te daban miedo, y no te dejarán.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera revenir sur toi toutes les maladies d’Égypte dont tu avais peur, et elles s’attacheront à toi.
fr.B: Il fera revenir sur toi toutes les maladies d’Égypte que tu redoutais, et elles s’attacheront à toi.
fr.R: Il fera venir de nouveau sur toi toutes les maladies d’Égypte qui te faisaient peur, et elles ne te quitteront pas.

sw.L: Naye atakurudishia magonjwa yote ya Misri uliyoyaogopa, nayo yatashikamana nawe.
sw.B: Atakurudishia magonjwa yote ya Misri uliyoyahofia, nayo yatashikamana nawe.
sw.R: Atakuletea tena magonjwa yote ya Misri yaliyokutisha, nayo hayatakuacha.

decisions.choice: the diseases of Egypt
decisions.reason: The LORD had promised to keep these diseases from an obedient Israel (7:15; Exodus 15:26). Now he will bring them back. Israel, rescued from Egypt, will suffer what Egypt suffered.

decisions.choice: cling: stay attached
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 21: the diseases will not leave.

source.text: גַּ֤ם כָּל־חֳלִי֙ וְכָל־מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Also every sickness and every plague which not [is] written in [the] book of the law this, he will bring them up Yahweh on you until you are destroyed.

en.L: Also every sickness and every plague that is not written in the book of this law, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring them up on you until you are destroyed.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will also bring on you every sickness and plague that is not written in this book of the law, until you are destroyed.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will also send on you every other sickness and disaster, even those not written in this book of teaching, until you are destroyed.

es.L: También toda enfermedad y toda plaga que no está escrita en el libro de esta ley, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las hará subir sobre ti hasta que seas destruido.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} traerá también sobre ti toda enfermedad y toda plaga que no está escrita en este libro de la ley, hasta que seas destruido.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará también sobre ti cualquier otra enfermedad y desastre, aun los que no están escritos en este libro de enseñanza, hasta que seas destruido.

fr.L: Aussi toute maladie et tout fléau qui n’est pas écrit dans le livre de cette loi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les fera monter sur toi jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera aussi venir sur toi toute maladie et tout fléau qui n’est pas écrit dans ce livre de la loi, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra aussi sur toi toutes les autres maladies et tous les autres malheurs, même ceux qui ne sont pas écrits dans ce livre d’enseignement, jusqu’à ce que tu sois détruit.

sw.L: Pia kila ugonjwa na kila pigo ambalo halikuandikwa katika kitabu cha sheria hii, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayaleta juu yako mpaka uangamizwe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea pia kila ugonjwa na pigo lisiloandikwa katika kitabu hiki cha sheria, mpaka uangamizwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea pia kila ugonjwa mwingine na kila maafa, hata yale yasiyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki cha mafundisho, mpaka uangamizwe.

decisions.choice: not written in this book: no limit to the list
decisions.reason: The curses named are not all that may come; any other sickness or disaster can be added.

decisions.choice: the book of this law
decisions.reason: As in verse 58.

decisions.choice: teaching
decisions.reason: As in verse 58.

source.text: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹ֑ב כִּי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will be left [as] men of fewness, in place that you were like [the] stars of the heavens for multitude, because not you listened to [the] voice of Yahweh your God.

en.L: And you will be left few in number, whereas you were like the stars of the heavens in multitude, because you did not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Though you were as many as the stars in the sky, only a few of you will be left, because you did not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: There were as many of you as the stars in the sky, but only a few of you will be left, because you did not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} pocos en número, aunque {{plural_you:eran|erais}} como las estrellas del cielo en multitud, porque no escuchaste la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Aunque {{plural_you:eran|erais}} tantos como las estrellas del cielo, solo quedarán unos pocos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque no obedeciste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.R: {{plural_you:Eran|Erais}} tantos como las estrellas del cielo, pero solo quedarán unos pocos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque no {{plural_you:obedecieron|obedecisteis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

fr.L: Et vous resterez [comme] des gens en petit nombre, alors que vous étiez comme les étoiles des cieux en multitude, parce que tu n’as pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: Alors que vous étiez aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel, il ne restera de vous qu’un petit nombre, parce que tu n’as pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.R: Vous étiez aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel, mais il ne restera de vous qu’un petit nombre, parce que vous n’avez pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

sw.L: Nanyi mtabaki watu wachache, ingawa mlikuwa kama nyota za mbinguni kwa wingi, kwa sababu hukuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Ingawa mlikuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, mtabaki wachache tu, kwa sababu hukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.R: Mlikuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, lakini mtabaki wachache tu, kwa sababu hamkumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.

decisions.choice: like the stars of the heavens: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: The LORD promised Abraham descendants as many as the stars (Genesis 15:5; 22:17), and Moses has said the promise came true (1:10; 10:22). The curse undoes it.

decisions.choice: men of fewness: few people
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in 4:27 and 26:5 for a small number of people.

decisions.choice: Though you were (Balanced); There were (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the former great number first, as a contrast, and then the few who are left.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans for those left, "tú" for the one who did not listen (L, B); plural throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns plural for "you will be left" and "you were", then back to singular for "you did not listen". Literal and Balanced keep the switch; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

decisions.choice: "vous" for those left, "tu" for the one who did not listen (L, B); "vous" throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns plural for "you will be left" and "you were", then back to singular for "you did not listen ... your God". Literal and Balanced keep the switch; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

decisions.choice: "mtabaki", "mlikuwa" (plural) with "hukuisikiliza", "Mungu wako" (singular) (L, B); plural throughout (R)
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the Hebrew switch from plural to singular at Literal and Balanced; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural ("hamkumtii", "Mungu wenu").

source.text: וְ֠הָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, just as rejoiced Yahweh over you to do good to you and to multiply you, so will rejoice Yahweh over you to make perish you and to destroy you; and you will be torn from on the land where you [are] going there to possess it.

en.L: And it will be: as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rejoice over you to make you perish and to destroy you; and you will be torn away from the land that you are going into to take possession of.
en.B: Just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delighted in doing you good and making you many, so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will delight in making you perish and destroying you. You will be torn away from the land you are entering to take possession of.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was glad to do good things for you and to make you a great nation. In the same way, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be glad to destroy you and wipe you out. You will be pulled up from the land you are going into to take as your own.

es.L: Y sucederá que, así como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se gozó sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} bien y para {{plural_you:multiplicarlos|multiplicaros}}, así se gozará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} perecer y para {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}}; y {{plural_you:serán arrancados|seréis arrancados}} de sobre el suelo al que entras para tomar posesión de él.
es.B: Así como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se complació en {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} bien y en {{plural_you:multiplicarlos|multiplicaros}}, así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se complacerá en {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} perecer y en {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}}. {{plural_you:Serán arrancados|Seréis arrancados}} de la tierra en la que entras para tomar posesión de ella.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se alegraba de {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} bien y de {{plural_you:convertirlos|convertiros}} en una gran nación. De la misma manera, se alegrará de {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}} y {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} desaparecer. {{plural_you:Serán arrancados|Seréis arrancados}} de la tierra en la que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a entrar para {{plural_you:tomarla como suya|tomarla como vuestra}}.

fr.L: Et il arrivera que, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est réjoui à votre sujet de vous faire du bien et de vous multiplier, ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se réjouira à votre sujet de vous faire périr et de vous détruire ; et vous serez arrachés de dessus le sol où tu entres pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: De même que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pris plaisir à vous faire du bien et à vous rendre nombreux, de même {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra plaisir à vous faire périr et à vous détruire. Vous serez arrachés du pays où tu entres pour en prendre possession.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était heureux de vous faire du bien et de faire de vous une grande nation. De la même manière, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera heureux de vous détruire et de vous faire disparaître. Vous serez arrachés du pays où vous allez entrer pour le prendre.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyofurahi juu yenu kuwatendea mema na kuwazidisha, ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakavyofurahi juu yenu kuwaangamiza na kuwaharibu; nanyi mtang'olewa kutoka katika ardhi unayoiingia ili kuimiliki.
sw.B: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyofurahia kuwatendea mema na kuwafanya wengi, ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakavyofurahia kuwaangamiza na kuwaharibu. Mtang'olewa kutoka katika nchi unayoiingia ili kuimiliki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alifurahi kuwatendea mema na kuwafanya taifa kubwa. Vivyo hivyo, atafurahi kuwaangamiza na kuwafutilia mbali. Mtang'olewa kutoka katika nchi mnayoiingia ili muichukue iwe yenu.

decisions.choice: the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you
decisions.reason: The words are meant to shock. The LORD who delighted to bless Israel will carry out its punishment just as fully. The same picture is turned back to good in 30:9: the LORD will again rejoice over Israel for good, as he rejoiced over its ancestors.

decisions.choice: torn away: uprooted
decisions.reason: The verb is used of pulling something up by the roots or tearing it out (Proverbs 2:22; Psalm 52:7). Israel will be pulled out of its land.

decisions.choice: the land phrase as in verse 21
decisions.reason: The words about the land are those of verse 21 at each level.

source.text: וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And will scatter you Yahweh among all the peoples, from [the] end of the earth and to [the] end of the earth, and you will serve there gods other which not you have known, you and your fathers, wood and stone.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among all the peoples, from the end of the earth to the end of the earth, and there you will serve other gods that you have not known, you and your fathers, wood and stone.
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among all the peoples, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will serve other gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known, gods of wood and stone.
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among the nations all over the earth, from one end to the other. There you will worship other gods that you and your ancestors never knew, idols made of wood and stone.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te esparcirá entre todos los pueblos, desde un extremo de la tierra hasta el otro extremo de la tierra, y allí servirás a otros dioses que no has conocido, ni tú ni tus padres, de madera y de piedra.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dispersará entre todos los pueblos, de un extremo a otro de la tierra. Allí servirás a otros dioses que ni tú ni tus antepasados conocieron, dioses de madera y de piedra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dispersará entre las naciones por toda la tierra, de un extremo al otro. Allí adorarás a otros dioses que ni tú ni tus antepasados conocieron jamás, ídolos hechos de madera y de piedra.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te dispersera parmi tous les peuples, d’une extrémité de la terre à l’autre extrémité de la terre, et là tu serviras d’autres dieux que tu n’as pas connus, ni toi ni tes pères, du bois et de la pierre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te dispersera parmi tous les peuples, d’un bout à l’autre de la terre. Là, tu serviras d’autres dieux que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez connus, des dieux de bois et de pierre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te dispersera parmi les nations, partout sur la terre, d’un bout à l’autre. Là, tu adoreras d’autres dieux que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez jamais connus, des idoles faites de bois et de pierre.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakutawanya kati ya mataifa yote, kutoka mwisho wa dunia hadi mwisho wa dunia, nawe utaitumikia huko miungu mingine usiyoijua, wewe wala baba zako, ya mti na jiwe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakutawanya kati ya mataifa yote, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa dunia hadi mwingine. Huko utaitumikia miungu mingine ambayo wewe wala mababu zako hamkuijua, miungu ya mti na ya jiwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakutawanya kati ya mataifa duniani kote, kutoka upande mmoja hadi mwingine. Huko utaabudu miungu mingine ambayo wewe na mababu zako hamkuwahi kuijua, sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa mti na jiwe.

decisions.choice: scatter you among all the peoples
decisions.reason: Moses warned of this scattering in 4:27-28, and Leviticus 26:33 says the same.

decisions.choice: other gods, wood and stone: as in verse 36
decisions.reason: Idols made by human hands.

decisions.choice: as in verse 36
decisions.reason: The wording for the gods follows verse 36 at each level.

source.text: וּבַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָהֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנ֖וֹחַ לְכַף־רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְנָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְכִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְדַֽאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And among the nations those not you will find rest, and not will be a resting place for [the] sole of your foot; and will give Yahweh to you there a heart trembling and failing of eyes and despair of soul.

en.L: And among those nations you will find no rest, and there will be no resting place for the sole of your foot; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you there a trembling heart and failing of eyes and despair of soul.
en.B: Among those nations you will find no rest, no place to rest the sole of your foot. There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you an anxious heart, eyes worn out with longing and a despairing spirit.
en.R: Among those nations you will never be at ease, and you will never have a place to settle. There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make you always afraid. Your eyes will grow tired from waiting for help, and you will lose all hope.

es.L: Y entre esas naciones no hallarás reposo, ni habrá lugar de descanso para la planta de tu pie; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará allí un corazón tembloroso, y ojos que desfallecen, y un alma abatida.
es.B: Entre esas naciones no encontrarás descanso, ningún lugar donde apoyar la planta del pie. Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará un corazón inquieto, ojos cansados de esperar y un espíritu desesperado.
es.R: Entre esas naciones nunca estarás tranquilo, y nunca tendrás un lugar donde establecerte. Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que vivas siempre con miedo. Tus ojos se cansarán de esperar ayuda, y perderás toda esperanza.

fr.L: Et parmi ces nations tu ne trouveras pas de repos, et il n’y aura pas de lieu de repos pour la plante de ton pied ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera là un cœur tremblant, et des yeux qui se consument, et une âme qui défaille.
fr.B: Parmi ces nations, tu ne trouveras pas de repos, aucun endroit où poser la plante de ton pied. Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera un cœur inquiet, des yeux usés par l’attente et un esprit désespéré.
fr.R: Parmi ces nations, tu ne seras jamais tranquille, et tu n’auras jamais d’endroit où t’installer. Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fera vivre dans une peur continuelle. Tes yeux se fatigueront à attendre du secours, et tu perdras tout espoir.

sw.L: Na kati ya mataifa hayo hutapata pumziko, wala hakutakuwa na mahali pa kutulia kwa wayo wa mguu wako; na huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa moyo wenye hofu, na macho yanayofifia, na nafsi inayozimia.
sw.B: Kati ya mataifa hayo hutapata pumziko, wala mahali pa kuweka wayo wa mguu wako. Huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa moyo wenye wasiwasi, macho yaliyochoka kwa kungoja, na nafsi iliyokata tamaa.
sw.R: Kati ya mataifa hayo hutatulia kamwe, wala hutapata mahali pa kukaa. Huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanya uishi kwa hofu daima. Macho yako yatachoka kwa kungoja msaada, nawe utakata tamaa kabisa.

decisions.choice: no resting place for the sole of your foot: nowhere to settle
decisions.reason: The words recall the dove that found no place to rest its foot and came back to the ark (Genesis 8:9).

decisions.choice: failing of eyes: as in verse 32
decisions.reason: Eyes worn out with looking for help that never comes.

decisions.choice: despair of soul: the inner life fading away
decisions.reason: The word for "soul" is the whole living self. Its "despair" is a pining or fainting away, the loss of all hope.

decisions.choice: always afraid
decisions.reason: Readable says what a trembling heart means.

source.text: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be your life hung for you in front, and you will be in dread night and day, and not you will trust in your life.

en.L: And your life will be hanging [in doubt] before you, and you will be in dread night and day, and you will not be sure of your life.
en.B: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will live in dread night and day, never sure that you will survive.
en.R: Your life will always be in danger. You will be terrified night and day, never knowing whether you will live.

es.L: Y tu vida estará pendiente [de un hilo] delante de ti, y vivirás aterrado noche y día, y no estarás seguro de tu vida.
es.B: Tu vida estará en vilo delante de ti. Vivirás con pavor noche y día, sin estar nunca seguro de sobrevivir.
es.R: Tu vida siempre estará en peligro. Tendrás terror noche y día, sin saber nunca si vivirás.

fr.L: Et ta vie sera suspendue [dans le doute] devant toi, et tu seras dans l’effroi nuit et jour, et tu ne seras pas sûr de ta vie.
fr.B: Ta vie sera comme suspendue à un fil devant toi. Tu vivras dans l’effroi nuit et jour, sans jamais être sûr de survivre.
fr.R: Ta vie sera toujours en danger. Tu seras terrifié nuit et jour, sans jamais savoir si tu vivras.

sw.L: Na maisha yako yataning'inia [kwa mashaka] mbele yako, nawe utaogopa usiku na mchana, wala hutakuwa na hakika ya maisha yako.
sw.B: Maisha yako yataning'inia kwa mashaka mbele yako. Utaishi kwa hofu kuu usiku na mchana, bila kuwa na hakika kwamba utaendelea kuishi.
sw.R: Maisha yako yatakuwa hatarini daima. Utaogopa sana usiku na mchana, bila kujua kama utaishi.

decisions.choice: your life will be hanging before you: in constant danger
decisions.reason: Life hangs as if by a thread, with no assurance that it will last.

decisions.choice: not be sure of your life: have no confidence that you will live
decisions.reason: The verb means to trust or be firm; here, to feel no certainty that one will stay alive (Job 24:22).

decisions.choice: [in doubt]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words English needs to make sense of "hanging".

source.text: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In the morning you will say, Who will give evening? and in the evening you will say, Who will give morning? from [the] dread of your heart which you will dread and from [the] sight of your eyes which you will see.

en.L: In the morning you will say, 'Who will give [it to be] evening!' and in the evening you will say, 'Who will give [it to be] morning!' because of the dread of your heart that you will dread and because of the sight of your eyes that you will see.
en.B: In the morning you will say, 'If only evening would come!' and in the evening, 'If only morning would come!' because of the dread that fills your heart and the sights your eyes will see.
en.R: When morning comes you will say, 'I wish it were evening!' And when evening comes you will say, 'I wish it were morning!' You will feel this way because of the terror in your heart and the terrible things you will see.

es.L: En la mañana dirás: “¡Quién me diera [que llegue] la tarde!”, y en la tarde dirás: “¡Quién me diera [que llegue] la mañana!”, por el pavor de tu corazón que te aterrará y por la visión de tus ojos que verás.
es.B: Por la mañana dirás: “¡Ojalá llegara la tarde!”, y por la tarde: “¡Ojalá llegara la mañana!”, por el pavor que llenará tu corazón y por lo que verán tus ojos.
es.R: Cuando llegue la mañana dirás: “¡Cómo quisiera que ya fuera de tarde!”. Y cuando llegue la tarde dirás: “¡Cómo quisiera que ya fuera de mañana!”. Te sentirás así por el terror que tendrás en el corazón y por las cosas terribles que verás.

fr.L: Le matin tu diras : “Qui donnera [que ce soit] le soir !” et le soir tu diras : “Qui donnera [que ce soit] le matin !”, à cause de l’effroi de ton cœur dont tu seras effrayé, et à cause du spectacle de tes yeux que tu verras.
fr.B: Le matin, tu diras : “Si seulement le soir pouvait venir !” et le soir : “Si seulement le matin pouvait venir !”, à cause de l’effroi qui remplira ton cœur et de ce que tes yeux verront.
fr.R: Quand viendra le matin, tu diras : “Je voudrais que ce soit déjà le soir !” Et quand viendra le soir, tu diras : “Je voudrais que ce soit déjà le matin !” Tu ressentiras cela à cause de la terreur dans ton cœur et des choses terribles que tu verras.

sw.L: Asubuhi utasema, 'Nani atakayetoa [iwe] jioni!' na jioni utasema, 'Nani atakayetoa [iwe] asubuhi!' kwa sababu ya hofu ya moyo wako utakayoiogopa, na kwa sababu ya maono ya macho yako utakayoyaona.
sw.B: Asubuhi utasema, 'Afadhali jioni ifike!' na jioni, 'Afadhali asubuhi ifike!' kwa sababu ya hofu itakayoujaza moyo wako na ya mambo ambayo macho yako yataona.
sw.R: Asubuhi ikifika utasema, 'Natamani iwe jioni sasa!' Na jioni ikifika utasema, 'Natamani iwe asubuhi sasa!' Utajisikia hivyo kwa sababu ya hofu iliyo moyoni mwako na mambo ya kutisha utakayoyaona.

decisions.choice: Who will give ...: If only ...
decisions.reason: "Who will give" is a Hebrew way of saying "if only" (5:29). Each part of the day is so dreadful that people long for the next.

decisions.choice: because of the dread ... and the sight
decisions.reason: The reason is given twice: the fear inside them and what they see around them (verse 34).

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: These words are quoted inside Moses' speech, so they take single quotation marks.

source.text: וֶֽהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨יְהוָ֥ה׀מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will bring you back Yahweh [to] Egypt in ships, by the way which I said to you, Not you will again see it, and you will sell yourselves there to your enemies as male slaves and as female slaves, and there [will be] no buyer.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way about which I said to you, 'You will never see it again'; and there you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male slaves and as female slaves, but [there will be] no one buying."
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way I promised you would never see again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as slaves, men and women, but there will be no buyer."
en.R: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send you back to Egypt in ships, on the journey I told you that you would never make again. There you will try to sell yourselves to your enemies as slaves, but no one will want to buy you."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará volver a Egipto en naves, por el camino del cual te dije: “Nunca más lo verás”; y allí {{plural_you:se venderán|os venderéis}} a tus enemigos como esclavos y como esclavas, pero [no habrá] quien compre».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará volver a Egipto en barcos, por el camino que te dije que nunca volverías a ver. Allí {{plural_you:se ofrecerán|os ofreceréis}} en venta a tus enemigos como esclavos y esclavas, pero no habrá comprador».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te enviará de vuelta a Egipto en barcos, en ese viaje que te dije que nunca volverías a hacer. Allí tratarás de venderte como esclavo a tus enemigos, pero nadie querrá comprarte».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te ramènera en Égypte sur des navires, par le chemin dont je t’ai dit : “Tu ne le reverras plus” ; et là vous vous vendrez à tes ennemis comme esclaves hommes et comme esclaves femmes, mais [il n’y aura] personne pour acheter. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te ramènera en Égypte sur des navires, par le chemin dont je t’avais dit que tu ne le reverrais jamais. Là, vous vous mettrez en vente auprès de tes ennemis comme esclaves, hommes et femmes, mais il n’y aura pas d’acheteur. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te renverra en Égypte sur des navires, pour ce voyage dont je t’avais dit que tu ne le referais jamais. Là, tu essaieras de te vendre comme esclave à tes ennemis, mais personne ne voudra t’acheter. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakurudisha Misri kwa meli, kwa njia ile niliyokuambia, 'Hutaiona tena kamwe'; na huko mtajiuza kwa adui zako kama watumwa wa kiume na watumwa wa kike, lakini [hakutakuwa na] mnunuzi."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakurudisha Misri kwa meli, kwa njia ile niliyokuahidi kwamba hutaiona tena. Huko mtajitoa kuuzwa kwa adui zako kama watumwa, wanaume na wanawake, lakini hakutakuwa na mnunuzi."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakurudisha Misri kwa meli, katika safari ile niliyokuambia kwamba hutaifanya tena. Huko utajaribu kujiuza kama mtumwa kwa adui zako, lakini hakuna atakayetaka kukununua."

decisions.choice: back to Egypt by the way you will never see again: the exodus undone
decisions.reason: The LORD had said that Israel must never go back to Egypt (17:16; Exodus 14:13). The last curse is a return to the land of slavery, as if the rescue from Egypt had never happened.

decisions.choice: I said to you: Moses passing on the LORD's word
decisions.reason: In 17:16 it is the LORD who said "You shall never again return that way". Here Moses says "I said", either because he gave that word to Israel or because, as in verse 20, the LORD's own voice speaks through him.

decisions.choice: in ships; you will sell yourselves, but no one will buy
decisions.reason: Ships may point to captives carried off and sold by traders over the sea (Ezekiel 27:13; Joel 4:6). The verb means to offer oneself for sale. Israel will be worth so little that no one will want them even as slaves.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: People are offered for sale as property here, so "slaves" stays at every level.

decisions.choice: closing quotation mark
decisions.reason: Moses' words, which opened at 27:12, end with this verse, so the double quotation mark closes here.

decisions.choice: "vous vous vendrez" (plural) inside a singular sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns plural only for "you will sell yourselves"; Literal and Balanced keep the switch. Readable, whose sentence starts in the singular, keeps "tu" throughout.

source.text: אֵלֶּה֩ דִבְרֵ֨י הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲֽשֶׁר־צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְרֹ֛ת אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב מִלְּבַ֣ד הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֥ת אִתָּ֖ם בְּחֹרֵֽב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] words of the covenant which commanded Yahweh Moses to make with [the] sons of Israel in [the] land of Moab, besides the covenant which he made with them at Horeb.

en.L: These [are] the words of the covenant that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses to make with the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with them at Horeb.
en.B: These are the words of the covenant {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses to make in the land of Moab with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, besides the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made with them at Horeb.
en.R: These are the terms of the covenant {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told Moses to make with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in the land of Moab. This covenant was in addition to the one {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made with them at Mount Horeb.

es.L: Estas [son] las palabras del pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó a Moisés hacer con los hijos de Israel en la tierra de Moab, además del pacto que hizo con ellos en Horeb.
es.B: Estas son las palabras del pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ordenó a Moisés hacer en la tierra de Moab con los israelitas, además del pacto que había hecho con ellos en Horeb.
es.R: Estos son los términos del pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés que hiciera con los israelitas en la tierra de Moab. Este pacto se añadía al que había hecho con ellos en el monte Horeb.

fr.L: Ce [sont] là les paroles de l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ordonna à Moïse de conclure avec les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël au pays de Moab, en plus de l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait conclue avec eux à l’Horeb.
fr.B: Ce sont là les paroles de l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ordonna à Moïse de conclure au pays de Moab avec les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, en plus de l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait conclue avec eux à l’Horeb.
fr.R: Voilà les termes de l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse de conclure avec les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} au pays de Moab. Cette alliance venait s’ajouter à celle qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait conclue avec eux au mont Horeb.

sw.L: Haya [ndiyo] maneno ya agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa kufanya na wana wa Israeli katika nchi ya Moabu, zaidi ya agano alilofanya nao huko Horebu.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo maneno ya agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa kufanya katika nchi ya Moabu na Waisraeli, mbali na agano alilokuwa amefanya nao huko Horebu.
sw.R: Haya ndiyo masharti ya agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa afanye na Waisraeli katika nchi ya Moabu. Agano hili liliongezwa juu ya lile alilokuwa amefanya nao katika Mlima Horebu.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: Hebrew 28:69 is 29:1 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does, where chapter 28 has 69 verses. Many Bibles begin chapter 29 with this verse, so 28:69 here is 29:1 there, and 29:1-28 here is 29:2-29 there. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: These are the words: a heading that looks back or forward
decisions.reason: The verse may close the covenant teaching of chapters 5-28, as the Hebrew chapter division takes it, or introduce the speech that begins in 29:1, as the other numbering takes it. Similar lines both close (Leviticus 26:46) and open (1:1) sections. Either way it names what Moses has taught in Moab as covenant words.

decisions.choice: the covenant made at Horeb
decisions.reason: The covenant of Sinai, also called Horeb, made forty years earlier (5:2-3). The covenant in Moab renews it with the new generation about to enter the land.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The narrator speaks here, after Moses' words closed at the end of verse 68.

decisions.choice: "ordonna" (passé simple, L and B); "a dit" (passé composé, R)
decisions.reason: The narrator speaks again after Moses' words close, so French uses the passé simple of written narrative at Literal and Balanced and the passé composé at Readable.
